44struct PendingPoll {
45 bool active = false;
46 std::string server;
47 std::string room_code;
48 ENetAddress addr;
49 ENetSocket socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
50 Uint32 start_ticks = 0;
51 Uint32 last_send_ticks = 0;
52};
53
54PendingPoll g_pending_poll;
55
56void cancel_pending_poll() {
57 if (g_pending_poll.socket != ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
58 enet_socket_destroy(g_pending_poll.socket);
59 g_pending_poll.socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
60 }
61 g_pending_poll.active = false;
62 g_pending_poll.server.clear();
63 g_pending_poll.room_code.clear();
64 g_pending_poll.start_ticks = 0;
65 g_pending_poll.last_send_ticks = 0;
66}
67
68bool internet_exchange(const std::string &server, const ecl::Buffer &request,
69 ecl::Buffer &response, std::string &error) {
70 std::string host;
71 Uint16 port = 0;
72 if (!parse_host_port(server, host, port)) {
73 error = "Invalid server address.";
74 return false;
75 }
76
77 ENetAddress addr;
78 if (enet_address_set_host(&addr, host.c_str()) != 0) {
79 error = "Failed to resolve server.";
80 return false;
81 }
82 addr.port = port;
83
84 ENetSocket socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
85 if (socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
86 error = "Failed to open socket.";
87 return false;
88 }
89 ENetBuffer eb;
90 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(request.data());
91 eb.dataLength = request.size();
92 if (enet_socket_send(socket, &addr, &eb, 1) <= 0) {
93 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
94 error = "Failed to send request.";
95 return false;
96 }
97
98 char data[1024];
99 ENetBuffer rb;
100 rb.data = data;
101 rb.dataLength = sizeof(data);
102 Uint32 start = SDL_GetTicks();
103 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start < 1500) {
104 enet_uint32 condition = ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE;
105 enet_socket_wait(socket, &condition, 50);
106 if ((condition & ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE) == 0)
107 continue;
108 ENetAddress src;
109 int received = enet_socket_receive(socket, &src, &rb, 1);
110 if (received > 0) {
111 response.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
112 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
113 return true;
114 }
115 }
116
117 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
118 error = "No response from server.";
119 return false;
120}
121
122bool internet_poll_start(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
123 std::string &error) {
124 cancel_pending_poll();
125
126 std::string host;
127 Uint16 port = 0;
128 if (!parse_host_port(server, host, port)) {
129 error = "Invalid server address.";
130 return false;
131 }
132
133 ENetAddress addr;
134 if (enet_address_set_host(&addr, host.c_str()) != 0) {
135 error = "Failed to resolve server.";
136 return false;
137 }
138 addr.port = port;
139
140 ENetSocket socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
141 if (socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
142 error = "Failed to open socket.";
143 return false;
144 }
145
146 ecl::Buffer request;
147 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_POLL)
148 << room_code;
149
150 ENetBuffer eb;
151 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(request.data());
152 eb.dataLength = request.size();
153 if (enet_socket_send(socket, &addr, &eb, 1) <= 0) {
154 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
155 error = "Failed to send request.";
156 return false;
157 }
158
159 g_pending_poll.active = true;
160 g_pending_poll.server = server;
161 g_pending_poll.room_code = room_code;
162 g_pending_poll.addr = addr;
163 g_pending_poll.socket = socket;
164 g_pending_poll.start_ticks = SDL_GetTicks();
165 g_pending_poll.last_send_ticks = g_pending_poll.start_ticks;
166 return true;
167}
168
169bool internet_poll_pump(ecl::Buffer &response, std::string &error) {
170 if (!g_pending_poll.active || g_pending_poll.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
171 error = "waiting";
172 return false;
173 }
174
175 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
176
177 // Resend once in case the datagram was dropped.
178 if (now - g_pending_poll.last_send_ticks > 500 && now - g_pending_poll.start_ticks < 1200) {
179 ecl::Buffer request;
180 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_POLL)
181 << g_pending_poll.room_code;
182 ENetBuffer eb;
183 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(request.data());
184 eb.dataLength = request.size();
185 enet_socket_send(g_pending_poll.socket, &g_pending_poll.addr, &eb, 1);
186 g_pending_poll.last_send_ticks = now;
187 }
188
189 char data[1024];
190 ENetBuffer rb;
191 rb.data = data;
192 rb.dataLength = sizeof(data);
193
194 enet_uint32 condition = ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE;
195 enet_socket_wait(g_pending_poll.socket, &condition, 0);
196 if ((condition & ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE) != 0) {
197 ENetAddress src;
198 int received = enet_socket_receive(g_pending_poll.socket, &src, &rb, 1);
199 if (received > 0) {
200 response.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
201 cancel_pending_poll();
202 return true;
203 }
204 }
205
206 if (now - g_pending_poll.start_ticks > 1500) {
207 cancel_pending_poll();
208 error = "No response from server.";
209 return false;
210 }
211
212 error = "waiting";
213 return false;
214}

216} // namespace

218bool InternetCreateRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
219 const protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &error) {
220 ensure_lobby_identity();
221 ecl::Buffer request;
222 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_CREATE)
223 << room_code << Uint32(start.session_id) << Uint32(start.seed)
224 << Uint8(start.expected_players) << Uint16(start.host_port)
225 << Uint8(start.filter_optimized) << start.level_id << start.host_id << start.pack_name;
226
227 ecl::Buffer response;
228 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
229 return false;
230
231 Uint32 magic = 0;
232 Uint8 version = 0;
233 Uint8 type = 0;
234 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
235 return false;
236 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
237 return false;
238 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
239 std::string msg;
240 response >> msg;
241 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
242 return false;
243 }
244 if (type != INET_CREATE_OK)
245 return false;
246 std::string host_ip;
247 std::string server_room;
248 if (!(response >> server_room >> host_ip))
249 return false;
250 (void)host_ip;
251 return true;
252}
253
254bool InternetJoinRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
255 protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &host_ip,
256 unsigned &player_count, std::string &error) {
257 ensure_lobby_identity();
258 player_count = 0;
259 ecl::Buffer request;
260 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_JOIN)
261 << room_code << g_lobby.local_id;
262
263 ecl::Buffer response;
264 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
265 return false;
266
267 Uint32 magic = 0;
268 Uint8 version = 0;
269 Uint8 type = 0;
270 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
271 return false;
272 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
273 return false;
274 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
275 std::string msg;
276 response >> msg;
277 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
278 return false;
279 }
280 if (type != INET_JOIN_OK)
281 return false;
282 if (!(response >> start.session_id >> start.level_id >> start.seed
283 >> start.expected_players >> start.host_port >> start.host_id
284 >> start.filter_optimized >> host_ip))
285 return false;
286 // Optional fields for newer servers:
287 // - player_count (u8)
288 // - pack_name (string)
289 if (response.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(response.size())) {
290 Uint8 count = 0;
291 if (response >> count)
292 player_count = count;
293 }
294 start.pack_name.clear();
295 if (response.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(response.size())) {
296 if (!(response >> start.pack_name))
297 return false;
298 }
299 return true;
300}
301
302bool InternetStartRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
303 const protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &error) {
304 ensure_lobby_identity();
305 ecl::Buffer request;
306 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_START)
307 << room_code << Uint32(start.session_id) << Uint32(start.seed)
308 << Uint8(start.expected_players) << Uint16(start.host_port)
309 << Uint8(start.filter_optimized) << start.level_id << start.host_id << start.pack_name;
310
311 ecl::Buffer response;
312 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
313 return false;
314
315 Uint32 magic = 0;
316 Uint8 version = 0;
317 Uint8 type = 0;
318 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
319 return false;
320 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
321 return false;
322 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
323 std::string msg;
324 response >> msg;
325 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
326 return false;
327 }
328 if (type != INET_START_OK)
329 return false;
330 return true;
331}
332
333bool InternetPollRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
334 protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &host_ip,
335 bool &started, unsigned &player_count, std::string &error) {
336 ensure_lobby_identity();
337 started = false;
338 player_count = 0;
339 ecl::Buffer response;
340 if (!g_pending_poll.active || g_pending_poll.server != server
341 || g_pending_poll.room_code != room_code) {
342 if (!internet_poll_start(server, room_code, error))
343 return false;
344 }
345 if (!internet_poll_pump(response, error))
346 return false;
347
348 Uint32 magic = 0;
349 Uint8 version = 0;
350 Uint8 type = 0;
351 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
352 return false;
353 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
354 return false;
355 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
356 std::string msg;
357 response >> msg;
358 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
359 return false;
360 }
361 if (type != INET_POLL_OK)
362 return false;
363 Uint8 started_flag = 0;
364 Uint8 count = 0;
365 if (!(response >> started_flag >> count))
366 return false;
367 started = (started_flag != 0);
368 player_count = count;
369 if (!started)
370 return true;
371 if (!(response >> start.session_id >> start.level_id >> start.seed
372 >> start.expected_players >> start.host_port >> start.host_id
373 >> start.filter_optimized >> host_ip))
374 return false;
375 start.pack_name.clear();
376 if (response.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(response.size())) {
377 // Pack name may be appended after host_ip.
378 if (!(response >> start.pack_name))
379 return false;
380 }
381 return true;
382}
383
384bool InternetLeaveRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
385 std::string &error) {
386 ensure_lobby_identity();
387 // If we are leaving, drop any pending poll to avoid keeping an extra socket
388 // around and to prevent late responses from touching UI state.
389 cancel_pending_poll();
390 ecl::Buffer request;
391 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_LEAVE)
392 << room_code << g_lobby.local_id;
393
394 ecl::Buffer response;
395 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
396 return false;
397
398 Uint32 magic = 0;
399 Uint8 version = 0;
400 Uint8 type = 0;
401 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
402 return false;
403 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
404 return false;
405 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
406 std::string msg;
407 response >> msg;
408 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
409 return false;
410 }
411 return true;
412}

416}

51std::string encode_hex(const char *data, size_t len) {
52 static const char *hex = "0123456789ABCDEF";
53 std::string out;
54 out.reserve(len * 2);
55 for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
56 unsigned char c = static_cast<unsigned char>(data[i]);
57 out.push_back(hex[(c >> 4) & 0xF]);
58 out.push_back(hex[c & 0xF]);
59 }
60 return out;
61}
62
63bool decode_hex(const std::string &text, ecl::Buffer &out) {
64 if (text.empty() || (text.size() % 2) != 0)
65 return false;
66 out.clear();
67 for (size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); i += 2) {
68 char hi = text[i];
69 char lo = text[i + 1];
70 auto hexval = [](char c) -> int {
71 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
72 return c - '0';
73 if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
74 return 10 + (c - 'A');
75 if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
76 return 10 + (c - 'a');
77 return -1;
78 };
79 int h = hexval(hi);
80 int l = hexval(lo);
81 if (h < 0 || l < 0)
82 return false;
83 char byte = static_cast<char>((h << 4) | l);
84 out.write(byte);
85 }
86 return true;
87}

89void send_lobby_announce() {
90 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
91 return;
92 // Username can change in Options; refresh before broadcasting.
93 ensure_lobby_identity();
94 protocol::LobbyAnnounce msg;
95 msg.id = g_lobby.local_id;
96 msg.name = g_lobby.local_name;
97 msg.level_id = g_lobby.selected_level;
98 // Best-effort: include the currently selected pack for easier debugging/UI.
99 lev::Index *cur = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
100 msg.pack_name = cur ? cur->getName() : "";
101 msg.player_count = static_cast<Uint8>(g_lobby.peers.size() + 1);
102
103 ecl::Buffer buf;
104 protocol::encode_lobby_announce(buf, msg);
105
106 ENetBuffer eb;
107 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(buf.data());
108 eb.dataLength = buf.size();
109
110 ENetAddress addr;
111 addr.host = ENET_HOST_BROADCAST;
112 addr.port = kLobbyPort;
113 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
114}
115
116void send_lobby_announce_to(const ENetAddress &dst) {
117 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
118 return;
119 // Username can change in Options; refresh before sending.
120 ensure_lobby_identity();
121
122 protocol::LobbyAnnounce msg;
123 msg.id = g_lobby.local_id;
124 msg.name = g_lobby.local_name;
125 msg.level_id = g_lobby.selected_level;
126 lev::Index *cur = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
127 msg.pack_name = cur ? cur->getName() : "";
128 msg.player_count = static_cast<Uint8>(g_lobby.peers.size() + 1);
129
130 ecl::Buffer buf;
131 protocol::encode_lobby_announce(buf, msg);
132
133 ENetAddress addr = dst;
134 addr.port = kLobbyPort; // announces are always listened for on the lobby port
135 ENetBuffer eb;
136 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(buf.data());
137 eb.dataLength = buf.size();
138 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
139}
140
141void poll_lobby_socket() {
142 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
143 return;
144 ENetAddress src;
145 char data[512];
146 ENetBuffer buffer;
147 buffer.data = data;
148 buffer.dataLength = sizeof(data);
149
150 while (true) {
151 int received = enet_socket_receive(g_lobby.socket, &src, &buffer, 1);
152 if (received <= 0)
153 break;
154
155 std::string ip = address_to_ip_string(src);
156 if (ip.empty())
157 continue;
158
159 ecl::Buffer buf;
160 buf.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
161 protocol::LobbyAnnounce announce;
162 if (protocol::decode_lobby_announce(buf, announce)) {
163 if (announce.id == g_lobby.local_id)
164 continue;
165 // Some networks deliver broadcasts asymmetrically (or filter
166 // broadcast but allow unicast). If we heard a peer's announce,
167 // send a direct unicast announce back once so they can discover us
168 // even if they didn't receive our broadcast.
169 bool newly_seen = g_lobby.peers.find(announce.id) == g_lobby.peers.end();
170 LobbyPeerEntry &entry = g_lobby.peers[announce.id];
171 entry.peer.id = announce.id;
172 entry.peer.name = announce.name;
173 entry.peer.level_id = announce.level_id;
174 entry.peer.address = ip;
175 entry.peer.is_self = false;
176 entry.addr = src;
177 entry.addr.port = kLobbyPort;
178 entry.last_seen = g_lobby.time;
179 if (newly_seen) {
180 debug_log("mp lobby: saw peer id=%s name=%s ip=%s (announce-back)",
181 announce.id.c_str(), announce.name.c_str(), ip.c_str());
182 send_lobby_announce_to(src);
183 }
184 continue;
185 }
186
187 buf.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
188 protocol::LobbyStart start;
189 if (protocol::decode_lobby_start(buf, start)) {
190 if (start.host_id == g_lobby.local_id)
191 continue;
192 if (g_session.active)
193 continue;
194 if (start.session_id == g_lobby.last_session_id)
195 continue;
196 g_lobby.pending_start = start;
197 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.clear();
198
199 // Prefer the START sender address first: it's the address that just
200 // delivered the packet to us, so it is usually the most routable for
201 // a direct connect (notably across VMs / NAT).
202 auto it = g_lobby.peers.find(start.host_id);
203 if (!ip.empty())
204 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.push_back(ip);
205 if (it != g_lobby.peers.end()) {
206 const std::string &announce_ip = it->second.peer.address;
207 if (!announce_ip.empty() &&
208 (g_lobby.pending_host_ips.empty() || g_lobby.pending_host_ips[0] != announce_ip)) {
209 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.push_back(announce_ip);
210 }
211 }
212
213 if (debug_enabled()) {
214 std::string hosts;
215 for (size_t i = 0; i < g_lobby.pending_host_ips.size(); ++i) {
216 if (i)
217 hosts += ",";
218 hosts += g_lobby.pending_host_ips[i];
219 }
220 debug_log("mp lobby: start received session=%u pack=%s level_id=%s host_id=%s port=%u hosts=%s",
221 static_cast<unsigned>(start.session_id),
222 start.pack_name.c_str(),
223 start.level_id.c_str(),
224 start.host_id.c_str(),
225 static_cast<unsigned>(start.host_port),
226 hosts.c_str());
227 }
228 g_lobby.has_pending_start = true;
229 g_lobby.last_session_id = start.session_id;
230 }
231 }
232}
233
234void cleanup_lobby_peers() {
235 for (auto it = g_lobby.peers.begin(); it != g_lobby.peers.end();) {
236 if (g_lobby.time - it->second.last_seen > kPeerTimeout)
237 it = g_lobby.peers.erase(it);
238 else
239 ++it;
240 }
241}
242
243void send_unicast_announces() {
244 // Broadcast delivery can be flaky or asymmetric (notably across VMs). Once we
245 // know a peer's unicast address, also send announces directly to keep LAN
246 // discovery stable.
247 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
248 return;
249 for (auto &kv : g_lobby.peers) {
250 LobbyPeerEntry &entry = kv.second;
251 if (entry.addr.host == 0)
252 continue;
253 if (g_lobby.time - entry.last_unicast_sent < kAnnounceInterval)
254 continue;
255 send_lobby_announce_to(entry.addr);
256 entry.last_unicast_sent = g_lobby.time;
257 }
258}
259
260} // namespace

262void LobbyStart() {
263 if (g_lobby.active)
264 return;
265 if (!LoadMultiplayerConfig().enable_direct) {
266 // LAN mode has no relay. If direct connect is disabled, don't join the
267 // broadcast lobby (prevents confusing half-working LAN behavior).
268 debug_log("mp lobby: not starting (direct connect disabled)");
269 return;
270 }
271 g_lobby.active = true;
272 // Keep a stable lobby identity across LobbyStop/LobbyStart cycles.
273 // Internet mode uses the same identity for room membership; if the id changes,
274 // LEAVE requests may not remove the original member entry on the lobby server.
275 ensure_lobby_identity();
276 g_lobby.time = 0.0;
277 g_lobby.announce_timer = 0.0;
278 g_lobby.peers.clear();
279 g_lobby.has_pending_start = false;
280 g_lobby.pending_host_ips.clear();
281 g_lobby.last_session_id = 0;
282
283 g_lobby.socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
284 if (g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
285 debug_log("mp lobby: socket create failed");
286 g_lobby.active = false;
287 return;
288 }
289 if (!bind_lobby_socket(g_lobby.socket, kLobbyPort)) {
290 debug_log("mp lobby: bind failed port=%u", static_cast<unsigned>(kLobbyPort));
291 enet_socket_destroy(g_lobby.socket);
292 g_lobby.socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
293 g_lobby.active = false;
294 return;
295 }
296 debug_log("mp lobby: started port=%u id=%s name=%s",
297 static_cast<unsigned>(kLobbyPort),
298 g_lobby.local_id.c_str(),
299 g_lobby.local_name.c_str());
300 send_lobby_announce();
301}
302
303void LobbyStop() {
304 if (!g_lobby.active)
305 return;
306 if (g_lobby.socket != ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
307 enet_socket_destroy(g_lobby.socket);
308 g_lobby.socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
309 }
310 g_lobby.active = false;
311 g_lobby.peers.clear();
312}
313
314void LobbyTick(double dtime) {
315 if (!g_lobby.active)
316 return;
317 g_lobby.time += dtime;
318 g_lobby.announce_timer += dtime;
319 if (g_lobby.announce_timer >= kAnnounceInterval) {
320 g_lobby.announce_timer = 0.0;
321 send_lobby_announce();
322 send_unicast_announces();
323 }
324 poll_lobby_socket();
325 cleanup_lobby_peers();
326}

328std::vector<LobbyPeer> LobbyPeers() {
329 std::vector<LobbyPeer> result;
330 if (!g_lobby.active)
331 return result;
332 // Username can change in Options; keep UI up to date.
333 ensure_lobby_identity();
334 LobbyPeer self;
335 self.id = g_lobby.local_id;
336 self.name = g_lobby.local_name;
337 self.level_id = g_lobby.selected_level;
338 self.address = "localhost";
339 self.is_self = true;
340 result.push_back(self);
341 for (const auto &entry : g_lobby.peers) {
342 result.push_back(entry.second.peer);
343 }
344 return result;
345}

378protocol::LobbyStart BuildStartMessage(const std::string &level_id, unsigned expected_players,
379 const std::string &pack_name, unsigned filter_min_players) {
380 protocol::LobbyStart start;
381 std::random_device rd;
382 Uint32 seed = static_cast<Uint32>(rd() ^ SDL_GetTicks());
383 Uint32 session_id = static_cast<Uint32>((rd() << 16) ^ SDL_GetTicks());
384 start.session_id = session_id;
385 start.level_id = level_id;
386 start.pack_name = pack_name;
387 start.seed = seed;
388 start.expected_players = static_cast<Uint8>(expected_players);
389 start.host_port = kGamePort;
390 start.host_id = g_lobby.local_id;
391 if (filter_min_players < 1)
392 filter_min_players = 1;
393 if (filter_min_players > expected_players)
394 filter_min_players = expected_players;
395 start.filter_optimized = static_cast<Uint8>(filter_min_players);
396 return start;
397}

399void LobbyBroadcastStart(const protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
400 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
401 return;
402 ecl::Buffer buf;
403 protocol::encode_lobby_start(buf, start);
404
405 ENetBuffer eb;
406 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(buf.data());
407 eb.dataLength = buf.size();
408
409 // Broadcast for the "normal" LAN case.
410 ENetAddress addr;
411 addr.host = ENET_HOST_BROADCAST;
412 addr.port = kLobbyPort;
413 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
414
415 // Some networks deliver broadcasts asymmetrically (notably across VMs). If we
416 // already know peers' unicast addresses, also send the start message directly.
417 for (const auto &kv : g_lobby.peers) {
418 const LobbyPeerEntry &entry = kv.second;
419 if (entry.addr.host == 0)
420 continue;
421 ENetAddress dst = entry.addr;
422 dst.port = kLobbyPort;
423 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &dst, &eb, 1);
424 }
425}

427std::string EncodeStartToken(const protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
428 ecl::Buffer buf;
429 protocol::encode_lobby_start(buf, start);
430 return encode_hex(buf.data(), buf.size());

433bool DecodeStartToken(const std::string &token, protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
434 ecl::Buffer buf;
435 if (!decode_hex(token, buf))
436 return false;
437 return protocol::decode_lobby_start(buf, start);
438}

What changed vs upstream/master

119inline void encode_lobby_announce(ecl::Buffer &buf, const LobbyAnnounce &msg) {
120 buf << kLobbyMagic << kLobbyVersion << Uint8(LOBBY_ANNOUNCE)
121 << msg.id << msg.name << msg.level_id << Uint8(msg.player_count) << msg.pack_name;
122}
123
124inline bool decode_lobby_announce(ecl::Buffer &buf, LobbyAnnounce &msg) {
125 Uint32 magic = 0;
126 Uint8 version = 0;
127 Uint8 type = 0;
128 if (!(buf >> magic >> version >> type))
129 return false;
130 if (magic != kLobbyMagic || type != LOBBY_ANNOUNCE)
131 return false;
132 Uint8 count = 0;
133 if (version != kLobbyVersion)
134 return false;
135 if (!(buf >> msg.id >> msg.name >> msg.level_id >> count))
136 return false;
137 msg.player_count = count;
138 msg.pack_name.clear();
139 if (buf.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(buf.size())) {
140 if (!(buf >> msg.pack_name))
141 return false;
142 }
143 return true;
144}
145
146inline void encode_lobby_start(ecl::Buffer &buf, const LobbyStart &msg) {
147 buf << kLobbyMagic << kLobbyVersion << Uint8(LOBBY_START)
148 << Uint32(msg.session_id) << msg.level_id << Uint32(msg.seed)
149 << Uint8(msg.expected_players) << Uint16(msg.host_port) << msg.host_id
150 << Uint8(msg.filter_optimized) << msg.pack_name;
151}
152
153inline bool decode_lobby_start(ecl::Buffer &buf, LobbyStart &msg) {
154 Uint32 magic = 0;
155 Uint8 version = 0;
156 Uint8 type = 0;
157 Uint32 session_id = 0;
158 Uint32 seed = 0;
159 Uint8 expected = 0;
160 Uint16 host_port = 0;
161 if (!(buf >> magic >> version >> type))
162 return false;
163 if (magic != kLobbyMagic || version != kLobbyVersion || type != LOBBY_START)
164 return false;
165 if (!(buf >> session_id >> msg.level_id >> seed >> expected >> host_port >> msg.host_id))
166 return false;
167 msg.session_id = session_id;
168 msg.seed = seed;
169 msg.expected_players = expected;
170 msg.host_port = host_port;
171 if (!(buf >> msg.filter_optimized))
172 return false;
173 msg.pack_name.clear();
174 if (buf.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(buf.size())) {
175 if (!(buf >> msg.pack_name))
176 return false;
177 }
178 return true;
179}

187inline bool decode_input(ecl::Buffer &buf, InputPacket &msg) {

193 float mouse_y = 0.0f;

195 Uint8 activate_count = 0;

201 return false;

229 << float(msg.p0_x) << float(msg.p0_y) << float(msg.p1_x) << float(msg.p1_y)

233inline bool decode_sync(ecl::Buffer &buf, SyncPacket &msg) {
234 Uint8 type = 0;
235 Uint32 epoch = 0;
236 Uint32 tick = 0;
237 Uint32 random_state = 0;
238 float p0_x = 0.0f;
239 float p0_y = 0.0f;
240 float p1_x = 0.0f;
241 float p1_y = 0.0f;
242 Uint64 world_checksum = 0;
243 Uint64 actor_checksum = 0;
244 if (!(buf >> type))
245 return false;
246 if (type != NET_SYNC)
247 return false;
248 if (!(buf >> epoch >> tick >> random_state >> p0_x >> p0_y >> p1_x >> p1_y >> world_checksum >>
249 actor_checksum))
250 return false;
251 msg.epoch = epoch;
252 msg.tick = tick;
253 msg.random_state = random_state;
254 msg.p0_x = p0_x;
255 msg.p0_y = p0_y;
256 msg.p1_x = p1_x;
257 msg.p1_y = p1_y;
258 msg.world_checksum = world_checksum;
259 msg.actor_checksum = actor_checksum;
260 return true;
261}
262
263inline void encode_resync_request(ecl::Buffer &buf, const ResyncRequest &msg) {
264 buf << Uint8(NET_RESYNC_REQUEST) << Uint32(msg.epoch) << Uint32(msg.tick);
265}
266
267inline bool decode_resync_request(ecl::Buffer &buf, ResyncRequest &msg) {
268 Uint8 type = 0;
269 Uint32 epoch = 0;
270 Uint32 tick = 0;
271 if (!(buf >> type))
272 return false;
273 if (type != NET_RESYNC_REQUEST)
274 return false;
275 if (!(buf >> epoch >> tick))
276 return false;
277 msg.epoch = epoch;
278 msg.tick = tick;
279 return true;
280}
281
282inline void encode_resync_state(ecl::Buffer &buf, const ResyncState &msg) {
283 Uint16 count = static_cast<Uint16>(msg.actors.size());
284 buf << Uint8(NET_RESYNC_STATE) << Uint32(msg.epoch) << Uint32(msg.tick) << Uint32(msg.random_state)
285 << Uint16(count);
286 for (const auto &actor : msg.actors) {
287 buf << Uint32(actor.object_id) << Uint16(actor.actor_id) << Uint16(actor.owner)
288 << float(actor.x) << float(actor.y) << float(actor.vx) << float(actor.vy)
289 << Uint32(actor.controllers) << Uint16(actor.color) << Uint32(actor.name_hash);
290 }
291}
292
293inline bool decode_resync_state(ecl::Buffer &buf, ResyncState &msg) {
294 Uint8 type = 0;
295 Uint32 epoch = 0;
296 Uint32 tick = 0;
297 Uint32 random_state = 0;
298 Uint16 count = 0;
299 if (!(buf >> type))
300 return false;
301 if (type != NET_RESYNC_STATE)
302 return false;
303 if (!(buf >> epoch >> tick >> random_state >> count))
304 return false;
305 msg.epoch = epoch;
306 msg.tick = tick;
307 msg.random_state = random_state;
308 msg.actors.clear();
309 msg.actors.reserve(count);
310 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
311 ResyncActorState actor;
312 Uint32 object_id = 0;
313 Uint16 actor_id = 0;
314 Uint16 owner = 0;
315 float x = 0.0f;
316 float y = 0.0f;
317 float vx = 0.0f;
318 float vy = 0.0f;
319 Uint32 controllers = 0;
320 Uint16 color = 0xFFFF;
321 Uint32 name_hash = 0;
322 if (!(buf >> object_id >> actor_id >> owner >> x >> y >> vx >> vy >> controllers >> color >>
323 name_hash))
324 return false;
325 actor.object_id = object_id;
326 actor.actor_id = actor_id;
327 actor.owner = owner;
328 actor.x = x;
329 actor.y = y;
330 actor.vx = vx;
331 actor.vy = vy;
332 actor.controllers = controllers;
333 actor.color = color;
334 actor.name_hash = name_hash;
335 msg.actors.push_back(actor);
336 }
337 return true;
338}
339
340inline void encode_ready(ecl::Buffer &buf) {
341 buf << Uint8(NET_READY);
342}
343
344inline bool decode_ready(ecl::Buffer &buf) {
345 Uint8 type = 0;
346 if (!(buf >> type))
347 return false;
348 return type == NET_READY;
349}
350
351inline void encode_start(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint32 epoch) {
352 buf << Uint8(NET_START) << Uint32(epoch);
353}
354
355inline bool decode_start(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint32 &epoch) {
356 Uint8 type = 0;
357 if (!(buf >> type))
358 return false;
359 if (type != NET_START)
360 return false;
361 if (!(buf >> epoch))
362 return false;
363 return true;
364}
365
366inline void encode_pause(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint32 epoch, bool paused) {
367 buf << Uint8(NET_PAUSE) << Uint32(epoch) << Uint8(paused ? 1 : 0);
368}
369
370inline bool decode_pause(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint32 &epoch, bool &paused) {
371 Uint8 type = 0;
372 Uint32 parsed_epoch = 0;
373 Uint8 parsed_paused = 0;
374 if (!(buf >> type))
375 return false;
376 if (type != NET_PAUSE)
377 return false;
378 if (!(buf >> parsed_epoch >> parsed_paused))
379 return false;
380 epoch = parsed_epoch;
381 paused = parsed_paused != 0;
382 return true;
383}
384
385inline void encode_menu(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint32 epoch, Uint8 player, bool open) {
386 buf << Uint8(NET_MENU) << Uint32(epoch) << Uint8(player) << Uint8(open ? 1 : 0);
387}
388
389inline bool decode_menu(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint32 &epoch, Uint8 &player, bool &open) {
390 Uint8 type = 0;
391 Uint32 parsed_epoch = 0;
392 Uint8 parsed_player = 0;
393 Uint8 parsed_open = 0;
394 if (!(buf >> type))
395 return false;
396 if (type != NET_MENU)
397 return false;
398 if (!(buf >> parsed_epoch >> parsed_player >> parsed_open))
399 return false;
400 epoch = parsed_epoch;
401 player = parsed_player;
402 open = parsed_open != 0;
403 return true;
404}
405
406inline void encode_abort(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint32 epoch) {
407 buf << Uint8(NET_ABORT) << Uint32(epoch);
408}
409
410inline bool decode_abort(ecl::Buffer &buf, Uint32 &epoch) {
411 Uint8 type = 0;
412 Uint32 parsed_epoch = 0;
413 if (!(buf >> type))
414 return false;
415 if (type != NET_ABORT)
416 return false;
417 if (!(buf >> parsed_epoch))
418 return false;
419 epoch = parsed_epoch;
420 return true;
421}
422
423inline void encode_restart(ecl::Buffer &buf, const RestartPacket &msg) {
424 buf << Uint8(NET_RESTART) << Uint32(msg.restart_id) << Uint8(msg.level_restart);
425}
426
427inline bool decode_restart(ecl::Buffer &buf, RestartPacket &msg) {
428 Uint8 type = 0;
429 Uint32 restart_id = 0;
430 Uint8 level_restart = 0;
431 if (!(buf >> type))
432 return false;
433 if (type != NET_RESTART)
434 return false;
435 if (!(buf >> restart_id >> level_restart))
436 return false;
437 msg.restart_id = restart_id;
438 msg.level_restart = level_restart;
439 return true;
440}
441
442inline void encode_place(ecl::Buffer &buf, const PlacementPacket &msg) {
443 buf << Uint8(NET_PLACE) << Uint32(msg.restart_id) << Uint8(msg.player)
444 << Uint16(msg.x) << Uint16(msg.y);
445}
446
447inline bool decode_place(ecl::Buffer &buf, PlacementPacket &msg) {
448 Uint8 type = 0;
449 Uint32 restart_id = 0;
450 Uint8 player = 0;
451 Uint16 x = 0;
452 Uint16 y = 0;
453 if (!(buf >> type))
454 return false;
455 if (type != NET_PLACE)
456 return false;
457 if (!(buf >> restart_id >> player >> x >> y))
458 return false;
459 msg.restart_id = restart_id;
460 msg.player = player;
461 msg.x = x;
462 msg.y = y;
463 return true;
464}

22/*
23 * Relay message encoding/decoding.
24 *
25 * Shared between UDP relay and TCP relay to keep message framing identical.
26 */
27
28namespace enigma {
29namespace multiplayer {
30namespace internal {
31
32void encode_relay_header(ecl::Buffer &buf, RelayMessageType type, Uint32 session_id,
33 Uint32 client_id) {
34 buf << Uint32(kRelayMagic) << Uint8(kRelayVersion) << Uint8(type)
35 << Uint32(session_id) << Uint32(client_id);
36}
37
38bool decode_relay_header(const char *data, size_t len, RelayMessageType &type,
39 Uint32 &session_id, Uint32 &client_id,
40 const char *&payload, size_t &payload_len) {
41 ecl::Buffer buf;
42 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
43 Uint32 magic = 0;
44 Uint8 version = 0;
45 Uint8 raw_type = 0;
46 if (!(buf >> magic >> version >> raw_type >> session_id >> client_id))
47 return false;
48 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
49 return false;
50 type = static_cast<RelayMessageType>(raw_type);
51 size_t offset = static_cast<size_t>(buf.get_rpos());
52 if (offset > len)
53 return false;
54 payload = data + offset;
55 payload_len = len - offset;
56 return true;
57}
58

62bool SessionShouldDeferStart() {
63 if (!g_session.active)
64 return false;
65 // For the host we must be stricter than "phase says RUNNING": on some networks
66 // (notably VM NAT setups) a lobby START can be seen but the direct ENet connect
67 // never succeeds. In that case the host must keep the simulation deferred until
68 // the expected number of peers have actually connected and reported READY.
69 bool can_start = false;
70 if (g_session.host) {
71 can_start = (g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::RUNNING) || host_ready_to_start();
72 } else {
73 can_start = (g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::READY_TO_START ||
74 g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::RUNNING);
75 }
76 if (debug_enabled()) {
77 int v = can_start ? 0 : 1;
78 if (g_session.last_defer_start_log != v) {
79 debug_log("mp should defer start: %d", v);
80 g_session.last_defer_start_log = v;
81 }
82 }
83 return !can_start;
84}
85
86void SessionNotifyStartRequested() {
87 if (!g_session.active)
88 return;
89 if (debug_enabled())
90 debug_log("mp notify start requested (host=%d local=%u expected=%u)", g_session.host ? 1 : 0,
91 g_session.local_player, g_session.expected_players);
92 if (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::RUNNING)
93 g_session.phase = SessionState::Phase::WAITING_FOR_READY;
94 if (!g_session.host && local_can_send_ready() && !g_session.local_ready_sent) {
95 send_ready_to_host();
96 g_session.local_ready_sent = true;
97 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
98 }
99}
100
101void SessionNotifyRestart(bool level_restart) {
102 if (!g_session.active || !g_session.host)
103 return;
104 // If someone had the multiplayer ESC menu open, force-unpause before restarting.
105 if (g_session.paused) {
106 g_session.paused = false;
107 if (!g_session.menu_open.empty())
108 std::fill(g_session.menu_open.begin(), g_session.menu_open.end(), false);
109 server::Msg_Pause(false);
110 send_pause_to_peers(false);
111 }
112 g_session.restart_id += 1;
113 g_session.last_restart_id = g_session.restart_id;
114 send_restart_to_peers(level_restart);
115}
116
117bool SessionIsPaused() {
118 if (!g_session.active)
119 return false;
120 return g_session.paused;
121}
122
123void SessionRequestPause(bool paused) {
124 if (!g_session.active)
125 return;
126 if (g_session.host) {
127 if (g_session.paused == paused)
128 return;
129 g_session.paused = paused;
130 server::Msg_Pause(paused);
131 send_pause_to_peers(paused);
132 return;
133 }
134 send_pause_to_host(paused);
135}

139void debug_dump_steerable_actors(const char *tag) {
140 if (!debug_enabled())
141 return;
142 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
143 GetActors(actors);
144 unsigned dumped = 0;
145 for (auto *a : actors) {
146 if (!a || !a->isSteerable())
147 continue;
148 if (dumped >= 32) {
149 debug_log("mp actors(%s): ... (truncated)", tag);
150 return;
151 }
152 Value owner = a->getAttr("owner");
153 Value color = a->getAttr("color");
154 debug_log("mp actor(%s): kind=%s pos=(%.2f,%.2f) ctrl=%d owner=%s color=%s", tag,
155 a->getKind().c_str(), a->get_pos()[0], a->get_pos()[1], a->get_controllers(),
156 owner ? owner.to_string().c_str() : "nil",
157 color ? color.to_string().c_str() : "nil");
158 dumped += 1;
159 }
160 if (dumped == 0)
161 debug_log("mp actors(%s): none steerable", tag);
162}

164bool any_menu_open() {

172void host_update_pause_from_menu_state() {

175 return;
176 g_session.paused = want_pause;
177 server::Msg_Pause(want_pause);
178 send_pause_to_peers(want_pause);
179}

181void tick_abort_grace(double dtime) {
182 if (!g_session.abort_pending)
183 return;
184 g_session.abort_timer += dtime;
185 if (g_session.abort_timer < kAbortDeliveryGrace)
186 return;
187 const std::string message = g_session.abort_message;
188 g_session.abort_pending = false;
189 g_session.abort_timer = 0.0;
190 g_session.abort_message.clear();
191 abort_session_with_message(message.c_str());
192}

194} // namespace

196void begin_abort_after_grace(const char *message) {
197 if (!g_session.active)
198 return;
199 if (g_session.abort_pending)
200 return;
201 g_session.abort_pending = true;
202 g_session.abort_timer = 0.0;
203 g_session.abort_message = message ? message : "Game aborted. Ending session.";
204}
205
206void SessionSetMenuOpen(bool open) {
207 if (!g_session.active)
208 return;
209 if (g_session.host) {
210 unsigned player = g_session.local_player;
211 if (player < g_session.menu_open.size() && g_session.menu_open[player] != open) {
212 g_session.menu_open[player] = open;
213 host_update_pause_from_menu_state();
214 }
215 return;
216 }
217 if (!g_session.local_player_known)
218 return;
219 send_menu_to_host(open);
220}
221
222void SessionRequestAbort() {
223 if (!g_session.active)
224 return;
225 if (g_session.host) {
226 send_abort_to_peers();
227 begin_abort_after_grace("Game aborted. Ending session.");
228 return;
229 }
230 send_abort_to_host();
231 begin_abort_after_grace("Game aborted. Ending session.");
232}
233
234void SessionPrepareExtraActors() {
235 if (!g_session.active)
236 return;
237 g_session.level_players = compute_level_players();
238 if (g_session.level_players < 1)
239 g_session.level_players = 1;
240 add_extra_actors(g_session.level_players, g_session.expected_players);
241}

243void SessionSetupExtraPlayerStartPositions() {
244 if (!g_session.active)
245 return;
246 if (g_session.level_players == 0)
247 g_session.level_players = compute_level_players();
248 if (g_session.level_players < 1)
249 g_session.level_players = 1;
250
251 // Some levels run Lua/setup logic during WorldInitLevel that can overwrite
252 // controllers/owner for steerable actors (notably meditation pearls). Run a
253 // post-init rebalance to ensure authored multi-ball levels are distributed
254 // across session players as intended.
255 rebalance_authored_multi_ball_levels(g_session.level_players, g_session.expected_players);
256
257 g_session.placement_received.clear();
258 if (g_session.expected_players > 0) {
259 g_session.placement_received.resize(g_session.expected_players, false);
260 for (unsigned player = 0; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
261 if (!placement_required_for_player(player))
262 g_session.placement_received[player] = true;
263 }
264 }
265 auto_place_extra_players();
266 debug_dump_steerable_actors("post-place");
267}

269void SessionPrimeInputQueueForNewLevel() {
270 if (!g_session.active)
271 return;
272 // A new level/restart starts unpaused; any open menus from the prior run are discarded.
273 bool was_paused = g_session.paused;
274 g_session.paused = false;
275 if (!g_session.menu_open.empty())
276 std::fill(g_session.menu_open.begin(), g_session.menu_open.end(), false);
277 server::Msg_Pause(false);
278 if (was_paused && g_session.host)
279 send_pause_to_peers(false);
280
281 configure_input_session(g_session.expected_players);
282 g_session.desync_reported = false;
283 g_session.phase = SessionState::Phase::WAITING_FOR_START;
284 g_session.local_ready_sent = false;
285 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
286 g_session.has_pending_sync = false;
287 g_session.last_world_checksum = 0;
288 g_session.checksum_history.clear();
289 g_session.last_checksum_tick = UINT32_MAX;
290 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
291 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
292 g_session.resync_cooldown = 0.0;
293 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
294 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
295 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
296 g_session.level_players = 0;
297 g_session.placement_received.clear();
298 g_session.needs_placement.clear();
299 g_session.last_defer_start_log = -1;
300 if (g_session.host) {
301 for (auto &entry : g_session.peer_ready)
302 entry.second = false;
303 for (auto &entry : g_session.relay_ready)
304 entry.second = false;
305 }
306}

310void tick_advance_input_clock(double dtime) {
311 g_session.input_clock_accu += dtime;
312 if (g_session.input_clock_accu > 1.0)
313 g_session.input_clock_accu = 1.0;
314 while (g_session.input_clock_accu >= kInputTimestep) {
315 g_session.input_clock_accu -= kInputTimestep;
316 g_session.input_clock_tick += 1;
317 }
318}
319
320void tick_apply_pending_sync() {
321 if (!g_session.has_pending_sync)
322 return;
323 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
324 if (local_tick == g_session.pending_sync.tick) {
325 protocol::SyncPacket sync = g_session.pending_sync;
326 g_session.has_pending_sync = false;
327 handle_sync_current(sync);
328 } else if (local_tick > g_session.pending_sync.tick) {
329 protocol::SyncPacket sync = g_session.pending_sync;
330 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
331 if (lookup_checksum_sample(sync.tick, sample))
332 handle_sync_sample(sync, sample);
333 g_session.has_pending_sync = false;
334 }
335}
336
337void tick_update_resync_cooldown(double dtime) {
338 if (g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0)
339 return;
340 g_session.resync_cooldown -= dtime;
341 if (g_session.resync_cooldown < 0.0)
342 g_session.resync_cooldown = 0.0;
343}
344
345void tick_update_resync_inflight_timeout(double dtime) {
346 if (!g_session.resync_inflight)
347 return;
348 g_session.resync_inflight_timer += dtime;
349 if (g_session.resync_inflight_timer < kResyncInflightTimeout)
350 return;
351 debug_log("mp resync timeout: local tick=%u attempts=%u via=%s", input::CurrentTick(),
352 static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.resync_attempts),
353 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
354 g_session.telemetry.resync_inflight_timeouts += 1;
355 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
356 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
357 // Allow a retry on the next mismatch observation.
358 g_session.resync_cooldown = 0.0;
359}
360
361void tick_send_periodic_ready(double dtime) {
362 if (g_session.host || g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::WAITING_FOR_READY)
363 return;
364 g_session.ready_timer += dtime;
365 if (g_session.ready_timer < 0.5)
366 return;
367 if (local_can_send_ready()) {
368 send_ready_to_host();
369 g_session.local_ready_sent = true;
370 }
371 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
372}
373
374void tick_debug_report_missing_input() {
375 if (!debug_enabled() || !g_session.local_player_known || !input::IsNetworked())
376 return;
377 static uint32_t last_missing_tick = UINT32_MAX;
378 uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
379 if (tick == last_missing_tick)
380 return;
381 bool missing = false;
382 for (unsigned player = 0; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
383 if (!input::HasInput(tick, player)) {
384 debug_log("mp missing input: tick=%u player=%u", tick, player);
385 missing = true;
386 }
387 }
388 if (missing)
389 last_missing_tick = tick;
390}
391
392void tick_update_start_phase() {
393 if (g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::WAITING_FOR_READY && g_session.host) {
394 if (!host_ready_to_start())
395 return;
396 if (debug_enabled())
397 debug_log("mp host: start allowed");
398 g_session.input_epoch += 1;
399 g_session.debug_state_dumped = false;
400 configure_input_session(g_session.expected_players);
401 send_start_to_peers();
402 g_session.phase = SessionState::Phase::READY_TO_START;
403 }
404
405 if (g_session.phase != SessionState::Phase::READY_TO_START)
406 return;
407 server::Msg_StartGame();
408 // Msg_StartGame can still be deferred (e.g. host has not observed connected peers yet).
409 // Only transition to RUNNING once the session logic says we can actually start.
410 if (SessionShouldDeferStart())
411 return;
412 g_session.phase = SessionState::Phase::RUNNING;
413}
414
415void tick_host_periodic_sync(double dtime) {
416 if (!g_session.host)
417 return;
418 g_session.sync_timer += dtime;
419 if (g_session.sync_timer < kSyncInterval)
420 return;
421 g_session.sync_timer = 0.0;
422 send_sync_to_peers();
423}
424
425void shutdown_enet_host_state() {
426 if (g_session.relay_peer) {
427 enet_peer_disconnect(g_session.relay_peer, 0);
428 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
429 }
430 if (g_session.relay_handle) {
431 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
432 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
433 }
434
435 if (!g_session.host_handle)
436 return;
437 if (g_session.host) {
438 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players)
439 enet_peer_disconnect(entry.first, 0);
440 } else if (g_session.server_peer) {
441 enet_peer_disconnect(g_session.server_peer, 0);
442 }
443 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
444 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
445 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
446}
447
448} // namespace
449
450void SessionTick(double dtime) {
451 if (!g_session.active)
452 return;
453 if (g_session.abort_pending) {
454 process_network_events();
455 tick_abort_grace(dtime);
456 return;
457 }
458 // While paused we still need to pump the network (for unpause / disconnect),
459 // but we must not advance the input clock or emit inputs.
460 if (g_session.paused) {
461 process_network_events();
462 return;
463 }
464 g_session.no_payload_timer += dtime;
465 tick_advance_input_clock(dtime);
466 process_network_events();
467 if (!g_session.active)
468 return;
469 if (g_session.paused)
470 return;
471 if (g_session.abort_pending)
472 return;
473 if (!g_session.host && g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::RUNNING &&
474 g_session.no_payload_timer >= kClientNoPayloadDisconnectTimeout) {
475 abort_session_with_message("Lost connection to host. Ending session.");
476 return;
477 }
478 tick_apply_pending_sync();
479 record_checksum_sample();
480 tick_update_resync_cooldown(dtime);
481 tick_update_resync_inflight_timeout(dtime);
482 tick_send_periodic_ready(dtime);
483 tick_debug_report_missing_input();
484 tick_update_start_phase();
485 send_local_inputs();
486 tick_host_periodic_sync(dtime);
487}
488
489void SessionShutdown() {
490 if (!g_session.active)
491 return;
492 if (debug_enabled()) {
493 const auto &t = g_session.telemetry;
494 debug_log("mp telemetry: sync_current=%llu sync_sample=%llu "
495 "mismatch(pos=%llu rand=%llu actor=%llu world=%llu) "
496 "classified(diag_only=%llu rng_only=%llu soft_candidate=%llu) "
497 "rng_fixed=%llu resync(req=%llu resp=%llu applied=%llu timeout=%llu giveup=%llu)",
498 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.sync_current_total),
499 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.sync_sample_total),
500 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_pos),
501 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_rand),
502 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_actor),
503 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_world),
504 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_diagnostic_only),
505 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_rng_only),
506 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.mismatch_soft_resync_candidate),
507 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.rng_resync_applied),
508 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_requests_sent),
509 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_responses_recv),
510 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_applied),
511 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_inflight_timeouts),
512 static_cast<unsigned long long>(t.resync_giveups));
513 }
514 shutdown_enet_host_state();
515 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
516 g_session = SessionState();
517 input::Reset();
518}

45/* -------------------- Multiplayer session start -------------------- */
46/*
47 * Session start/join handshakes.
48 *
49 * Builds the transport connection (direct or relay) and initializes the
50 * deterministic runtime state before unpausing the simulation.
51 */
52
53namespace enigma {
54namespace multiplayer {
55namespace internal {
56
57void configure_input_session(unsigned expected_players) {
58 // The input stream is stamped for a future tick (input delay). A larger
59 // delay reduces the odds that a peer reaches a tick before receiving the
60 // other players' inputs for that tick.
61 g_session.input_delay =
62 (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY) ? kInputDelayTcpRelay : kInputDelay;
63 if (debug_enabled())
64 debug_log("mp input delay=%u transport=%s", static_cast<unsigned>(g_session.input_delay),
65 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
66 input::Reset();
67 input::SetNetworked(true);
68 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
69 for (uint32_t tick = 0; tick < g_session.input_delay; ++tick) {
70 for (unsigned player = 0; player < expected_players; ++player) {
71 input::EnqueueInput(tick, player, input::PlayerInput());
72 }
73 }
74 g_session.next_local_tick = g_session.input_delay;
75 g_session.next_send_tick = 0;
76 g_session.local_history.clear();
77 g_session.input_clock_tick = input::CurrentTick();
78 g_session.input_clock_accu = 0.0;
79}

83struct ConnectStrategy {
84 bool enabled;
85 const char *disabled_log;
86 bool (*attempt)(const protocol::LobbyStart &, const std::string &);
87};
88
89enum class JoinPhase {
90 IDLE = 0,
91 CONNECTING = 1,
92 WAIT_WELCOME = 2,
93 TCP_CONNECTING = 3,
94 TCP_WAIT_WELCOME = 4
95};
96
97struct ClientJoinState {
98 bool active = false;
99 protocol::LobbyStart start;
100 // Candidate IPs for direct-connect attempts (multi-homed hosts, VMs).
101 std::vector<std::string> host_ips;
102 MultiplayerConfig cfg;
103
104 // Ordered list of strategies to try (filtered by cfg).
105 std::vector<TransportKind> strategies;
106 size_t strategy_index = 0;
107 size_t direct_host_index = 0;
108
109 // Current attempt.
110 TransportKind attempt_kind = TransportKind::NONE;
111 bool relay_connect = false; // ENet relay HELLO is needed.
112 std::string target_host;
113 Uint16 target_port = 0;
114 JoinPhase phase = JoinPhase::IDLE;
115 Uint32 connect_deadline = 0;
116 Uint32 welcome_deadline = 0;
117
118 // TCP relay connect attempt state.
119 addrinfo *tcp_addrs = nullptr;
120 addrinfo *tcp_next = nullptr;
121};
122
123ClientJoinState g_join;
124
125void join_clear_network_state() {
126 if (g_session.host_handle) {
127 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
128 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
129 }
130 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
131 // Host-side relay state is not used for client joins.
132 if (g_session.relay_handle) {
133 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
134 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
135 }
136 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
137 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
138 g_session.tcp_relay_rx.clear();
139 g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len = 0;
140
141 if (g_join.tcp_addrs) {
142 freeaddrinfo(g_join.tcp_addrs);
143 g_join.tcp_addrs = nullptr;
144 }
145 g_join.tcp_next = nullptr;
146}
147
148void join_fail_current_attempt() {
149 join_clear_network_state();
150 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::IDLE;
151 g_join.relay_connect = false;
152 g_join.target_host.clear();
153 g_join.target_port = 0;
154}
155
156bool join_begin_enet_attempt(const std::string &host, Uint16 port, bool relay_connect,
157 Uint32 connect_timeout_ms, Uint32 welcome_timeout_ms) {
158 join_clear_network_state();
159 g_join.relay_connect = relay_connect;
160 g_join.target_host = host;
161 g_join.target_port = port;
162
163 g_session.host_handle = enet_host_create(nullptr, 1,
164#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
165 2 /* channels */,
166#endif
167 0, 0);
168 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr)
169 return false;
170
171 ENetAddress addr;
172 enet_address_set_host(&addr, host.c_str());
173 addr.port = port;
174 g_session.server_peer = enet_host_connect(g_session.host_handle, &addr, 2
175#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
176 ,
177 0 /* data */
178#endif
179 );
180 if (g_session.server_peer == nullptr) {
181 join_clear_network_state();
182 return false;
183 }
184
185 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
186 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::CONNECTING;
187 g_join.connect_deadline = now + connect_timeout_ms;
188 g_join.welcome_deadline = now + welcome_timeout_ms;
189 return true;
190}
191
192bool join_begin_tcp_relay_attempt(const std::string &host, Uint16 port) {
193 join_clear_network_state();
194 g_join.relay_connect = false;
195 g_join.target_host = host;
196 g_join.target_port = port;
197
198 if (host.empty() || port == 0)
199 return false;
200
201 addrinfo hints;
202 ::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
203 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
204 hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
205
206 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
207 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(port));
208 if (getaddrinfo(host.c_str(), port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0)
209 return false;
210 g_join.tcp_addrs = res;
211 g_join.tcp_next = res;
212
213 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
214 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING;
215 g_join.connect_deadline = now + 3000;
216 g_join.welcome_deadline = now + kJoinTimeoutMs;
217
218 // Start the first address attempt.
219 while (g_join.tcp_next) {
220 addrinfo *ai = g_join.tcp_next;
221 g_join.tcp_next = g_join.tcp_next->ai_next;
222
223 TcpSocket s = ::socket(ai->ai_family, ai->ai_socktype, ai->ai_protocol);
224 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
225 continue;
226 if (!tcp_set_nonblocking(s)) {
227 tcp_close(s);
228 continue;
229 }
230 int rc = ::connect(s, ai->ai_addr, static_cast<int>(ai->ai_addrlen));
231#ifdef WIN32
232 if (rc == 0) {
233 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = s;
234 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME;
235 } else {
236 int err = WSAGetLastError();
237 if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK && err != WSAEINPROGRESS) {
238 tcp_close(s);
239 continue;
240 }
241 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = s;
242 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING;
243 }
244#else
245 if (rc == 0) {
246 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = s;
247 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME;
248 } else {
249 if (errno != EINPROGRESS) {
250 tcp_close(s);
251 continue;
252 }
253 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = s;
254 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING;
255 }
256#endif
257
258 // If we're already connected, send the HELLO immediately.
259 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME) {
260 ecl::Buffer hello;
261 encode_relay_header(hello, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, g_join.start.session_id, 0);
262 if (!tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, hello.data(), hello.size())) {
263 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
264 continue;
265 }
266 }
267 return true;
268 }
269
270 join_clear_network_state();
271 return false;
272}
273
274bool join_begin_next_attempt() {
275 while (g_join.strategy_index < g_join.strategies.size()) {
276 TransportKind kind = g_join.strategies[g_join.strategy_index];
277 g_join.attempt_kind = kind;
278
279 if (kind == TransportKind::DIRECT) {
280 while (g_join.direct_host_index < g_join.host_ips.size()) {
281 const std::string &host = g_join.host_ips[g_join.direct_host_index++];
282 if (host.empty())
283 continue;
284 if (debug_enabled())
285 debug_log("mp client: connect %s:%u relay=0", host.c_str(),
286 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.start.host_port));
287 if (join_begin_enet_attempt(host, g_join.start.host_port, false,
288 kDirectConnectTimeoutMs,
289 kJoinTimeoutMs)) {
290 return true;
291 }
292 }
293 g_join.strategy_index++;
294 continue;
295 }
296 if (kind == TransportKind::UDP_RELAY) {
297 g_join.strategy_index++;
298 if (g_relay_server.empty())
299 continue;
300 if (debug_enabled())
301 debug_log("mp client: relay server=%s", g_relay_server.c_str());
302 std::string relay_host;
303 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
304 if (!parse_host_port(g_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
305 continue;
306 if (join_begin_enet_attempt(relay_host, relay_port, true, 2000, kJoinTimeoutMs)) {
307 return true;
308 }
309 continue;
310 }
311 if (kind == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY) {
312 g_join.strategy_index++;
313 if (g_tcp_relay_server.empty())
314 continue;
315 if (debug_enabled())
316 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay server=%s", g_tcp_relay_server.c_str());
317 std::string relay_host;
318 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
319 if (!parse_host_port(g_tcp_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
320 continue;
321 if (join_begin_tcp_relay_attempt(relay_host, relay_port)) {
322 return true;
323 }
324 continue;
325 }
326 }
327 return false;
328}
329
330void join_build_strategy_list() {
331 g_join.strategies.clear();
332 const bool enable_direct = g_join.cfg.enable_direct;
333 const bool enable_udp_relay = g_join.cfg.enable_udp_relay;
334 const bool enable_tcp_relay = g_join.cfg.enable_tcp_relay;
335 const bool force_relay = g_join.cfg.force_relay;
336
337 if (enable_direct && !force_relay && !g_join.host_ips.empty())
338 g_join.strategies.push_back(TransportKind::DIRECT);
339 if (enable_udp_relay)
340 g_join.strategies.push_back(TransportKind::UDP_RELAY);
341 if (enable_tcp_relay)
342 g_join.strategies.push_back(TransportKind::TCP_RELAY);
343
344 if (debug_enabled()) {
345 if (!enable_direct)
346 debug_log("mp client: direct connect disabled");
347 else if (force_relay)
348 debug_log("mp client: force relay enabled");
349 if (!enable_udp_relay)
350 debug_log("mp client: udp relay disabled");
351 if (!enable_tcp_relay)
352 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay disabled");
353 }
354}

356// Session startup helpers keep SessionStartHost/SessionStartClient short by isolating
357// transport-specific bootstrapping/handshake code paths.
358void reset_session_bootstrap(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, unsigned expected_players,
359 bool is_host, bool local_player_known, unsigned local_player) {
360 if (g_session.host_handle) {
361 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
362 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
363 }
364 if (g_session.relay_handle) {
365 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
366 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
367 }
368 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
369 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
370 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
371
372 g_session = SessionState();
373 g_session.active = true;
374 g_session.host = is_host;
375 g_session.local_player_known = local_player_known;
376 g_session.local_player = local_player;
377 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
378 g_session.session_id = start.session_id;
379 g_session.seed = start.seed;
380 g_session.menu_open.assign(expected_players, false);
381
382 enigma::Randomize(start.seed, true);
383 configure_input_session(expected_players);
384}
385
386bool host_open_direct_listener(Uint16 port, unsigned expected_players) {
387 ENetAddress address;
388 address.host = ENET_HOST_ANY;
389 address.port = port;
390 g_session.host_handle = enet_host_create(&address, expected_players - 1,
391#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
392 2 /* channels */,
393#endif
394 0, 0);
395 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr)
396 return false;
397 // Do not tweak ENet-managed sockets. ENet already configures non-blocking
398 // mode and buffering; overriding this can break connect/handshake on some
399 // platform builds.
400 return true;
401}
402
403void host_try_connect_udp_relay() {
404 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
405 if (!cfg.enable_udp_relay || g_relay_server.empty())
406 return;
407 if (debug_enabled())
408 debug_log("mp host: relay server=%s", g_relay_server.c_str());
409
410 std::string relay_host;
411 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
412 if (!parse_host_port(g_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
413 return;
414
415 if (g_session.relay_handle)
416 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
417 g_session.relay_handle = enet_host_create(nullptr, 1,
418#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
419 2 /* channels */,
420#endif
421 0, 0);
422 if (!g_session.relay_handle)
423 return;
424
425 ENetAddress relay_addr;
426 enet_address_set_host(&relay_addr, relay_host.c_str());
427 relay_addr.port = relay_port;
428 g_session.relay_peer = enet_host_connect(g_session.relay_handle, &relay_addr, 2
429#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
430 ,
431 0 /* data */
432#endif
433 );
434 if (!g_session.relay_peer) {
435 debug_log("mp host: relay connect failed %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
436 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
437 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
438 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
439 return;
440 }
441
442 ENetEvent event;
443 if (enet_host_service(g_session.relay_handle, &event, 3000) > 0 &&
444 event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT) {
445 g_session.relay_peer = event.peer;
446 ecl::Buffer buf;
447 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_HOST, g_session.session_id, 0);
448 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(),
449 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
450 enet_peer_send(g_session.relay_peer, 0, packet);
451 enet_host_flush(g_session.relay_handle);
452 debug_log("mp host: connected to relay %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
453 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
454 return;
455 }
456
457 debug_log("mp host: relay connect timeout %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
458 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
459 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
460 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
461 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
462}
463
464void host_try_connect_tcp_relay() {
465 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
466 if (!cfg.enable_tcp_relay || g_tcp_relay_server.empty())
467 return;
468 if (debug_enabled())
469 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay server=%s", g_tcp_relay_server.c_str());
470
471 std::string relay_host;
472 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
473 if (!parse_host_port(g_tcp_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
474 return;
475
476 TcpSocket sock;
477 if (!tcp_connect_timeout(relay_host, relay_port, 3000, sock)) {
478 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay connect failed %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
479 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
480 return;
481 }
482
483 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = sock;
484 ecl::Buffer buf;
485 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_HOST, g_session.session_id, 0);
486 if (tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, buf.data(), buf.size())) {
487 debug_log("mp host: connected to tcp relay %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
488 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
489 return;
490 }
491
492 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay hello failed %s:%u", relay_host.c_str(),
493 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
494 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
495}
496
497bool client_connect_and_wait_enet(const std::string &target_host, Uint16 target_port,
498 bool relay_connect, Uint32 connect_timeout_ms,
499 Uint32 welcome_timeout_ms, Uint32 session_id) {
500 if (debug_enabled())
501 debug_log("mp client: connect %s:%u relay=%d", target_host.c_str(),
502 static_cast<unsigned>(target_port), relay_connect ? 1 : 0);
503 if (g_session.host_handle) {
504 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
505 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
506 }
507 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
508 g_session.host_handle = enet_host_create(nullptr, 1,
509#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
510 2 /* channels */,
511#endif
512 0, 0);
513 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr)
514 return false;
515
516 ENetAddress addr;
517 enet_address_set_host(&addr, target_host.c_str());
518 addr.port = target_port;
519 g_session.server_peer = enet_host_connect(g_session.host_handle, &addr, 2
520#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
521 ,
522 0 /* data */
523#endif
524 );
525 if (g_session.server_peer == nullptr)
526 return false;
527
528 ENetEvent event;
529 if (!(enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, connect_timeout_ms) > 0 &&
530 event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT)) {
531 if (debug_enabled())
532 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u", target_host.c_str(),
533 static_cast<unsigned>(target_port));
534 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
535 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
536 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
537 return false;
538 }
539 g_session.server_peer = event.peer;
540 if (relay_connect) {
541 ecl::Buffer buf;
542 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, session_id, 0);
543 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(),
544 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
545 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
546 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
547 }
548
549 Uint32 start_wait = SDL_GetTicks();
550 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start_wait < welcome_timeout_ms) {
551 int res = enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, 100);
552 if (res <= 0)
553 continue;
554 if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE) {
555 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
556 ecl::Buffer buf;
557 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), event.packet->dataLength);
558 Uint8 player_id = 0;
559 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
560 Uint32 seed = 0;
561 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed)) {
562 if (debug_enabled())
563 debug_log("mp client: welcome player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
564 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id),
565 static_cast<unsigned>(expected_players),
566 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
567 g_session.local_player = player_id;
568 g_session.local_player_known = true;
569 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
570 g_session.seed = seed;
571 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
572 g_session.active_transport =
573 relay_connect ? TransportKind::UDP_RELAY : TransportKind::DIRECT;
574 if (debug_enabled())
575 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s",
576 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
577 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
578 return true;
579 }
580 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
581 } else if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT) {
582 break;
583 }
584 }
585
586 if (debug_enabled())
587 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u", target_host.c_str(),
588 static_cast<unsigned>(target_port));
589 if (g_session.server_peer) {
590 enet_peer_reset(g_session.server_peer);
591 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
592 }
593 if (g_session.host_handle) {
594 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
595 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
596 }
597 return false;
598}

600bool client_try_connect_direct(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
601 // Keep the actual connect timeout short, but allow a longer welcome window
602 // in case the host is still loading/binding when the client attempts to join.
603 return client_connect_and_wait_enet(host_ip, start.host_port, false, kDirectConnectTimeoutMs,
604 kJoinTimeoutMs, start.session_id);
605}

607bool client_try_connect_udp_relay(Uint32 session_id) {
608 if (!g_relay_server.empty()) {
609 if (debug_enabled())
610 debug_log("mp client: relay server=%s", g_relay_server.c_str());
611 std::string relay_host;
612 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
613 if (parse_host_port(g_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port)) {
614 if (client_connect_and_wait_enet(relay_host, relay_port, true, 2000, kJoinTimeoutMs,
615 session_id)) {
616 return true;
617 }
618 }
619 }
620 return false;

623bool client_try_connect_udp_relay(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
624 static_cast<void>(host_ip);
625 return client_try_connect_udp_relay(start.session_id);

627
628bool client_try_connect_tcp_relay(Uint32 session_id) {
629 if (g_tcp_relay_server.empty())
630 return false;
631 if (debug_enabled())
632 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay server=%s", g_tcp_relay_server.c_str());
633
634 // Ensure stale ENet state from previous attempts does not interfere with
635 // TCP relay operation (client_send_payload prefers server_peer if set).
636 if (g_session.host_handle) {
637 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
638 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
639 }
640 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
641
642 std::string relay_host;
643 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
644 if (!parse_host_port(g_tcp_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port))
645 return false;
646
647 TcpSocket sock;
648 if (!tcp_connect_timeout(relay_host, relay_port, 3000, sock)) {
649 if (debug_enabled())
650 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u (tcp relay)", relay_host.c_str(),
651 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
652 return false;
653 }
654 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = sock;
655
656 ecl::Buffer hello;
657 encode_relay_header(hello, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, session_id, 0);
658 if (!tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, hello.data(), hello.size())) {
659 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
660 return false;
661 }
662
663 Uint32 start_wait = SDL_GetTicks();
664 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
665 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start_wait < kJoinTimeoutMs) {
666 fd_set rfds;
667 FD_ZERO(&rfds);
668 FD_SET(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, &rfds);
669 timeval tv;
670 tv.tv_sec = 0;
671 tv.tv_usec = 100 * 1000;
672#ifdef WIN32
673 int sel = ::select(0, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
674#else
675 int sel = ::select(g_session.tcp_relay_socket + 1, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
676#endif
677 if (sel <= 0)
678 continue;
679 if (!tcp_pump_recv(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, g_session.tcp_relay_rx)) {
680 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
681 break;
682 }
683 while (tcp_try_extract_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_rx, g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len,
684 frame)) {
685 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data());
686 ecl::Buffer buf;
687 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), frame.size());
688 Uint8 player_id = 0;
689 Uint8 expected = 0;
690 Uint32 seed = 0;
691 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected, seed)) {
692 if (debug_enabled())
693 debug_log("mp client: welcome (tcp relay) player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
694 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id), static_cast<unsigned>(expected),
695 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
696 g_session.local_player = player_id;
697 g_session.local_player_known = true;
698 g_session.expected_players = expected;
699 g_session.seed = seed;
700 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected);
701 g_session.active_transport = TransportKind::TCP_RELAY;
702 if (debug_enabled())
703 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s",
704 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
705 return true;
706 }
707 }
708 }
709
710 if (debug_enabled())
711 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u (tcp relay)", relay_host.c_str(),
712 static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
713 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
714 return false;
715}
716
717bool client_try_connect_tcp_relay(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
718 static_cast<void>(host_ip);
719 return client_try_connect_tcp_relay(start.session_id);
720}

723
724bool SessionStartHost(const protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
725 if (g_session.active)
726 return false;
727 if (debug_enabled())
728 debug_log("mp debug enabled");
729 unsigned expected_players = std::min<unsigned>(start.expected_players, input::kMaxPlayers);
730 if (expected_players < 1)
731 return false;
732 reset_session_bootstrap(start, expected_players, true, true, 0);
733 if (!host_open_direct_listener(start.host_port, expected_players)) {
734 SessionShutdown();
735 return false;
736 }
737
738 host_try_connect_udp_relay();
739 host_try_connect_tcp_relay();
740 return true;
741}
742
743bool SessionStartClient(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
744 if (g_session.active)
745 return false;
746 if (debug_enabled())
747 debug_log("mp debug enabled");
748 unsigned expected_players = std::min<unsigned>(start.expected_players, input::kMaxPlayers);
749 if (expected_players < 1)
750 return false;
751 reset_session_bootstrap(start, expected_players, false, false, 1);
752 multiplayer::MultiplayerConfig cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
753 const bool enable_direct = cfg.enable_direct;
754 const bool enable_udp_relay = cfg.enable_udp_relay;
755 const bool enable_tcp_relay = cfg.enable_tcp_relay;
756 const bool force_relay = cfg.force_relay;
757 const char *direct_disabled_log =
758 !enable_direct ? "mp client: direct connect disabled"
759 : (force_relay ? "mp client: force relay enabled" : nullptr);
760
761 const ConnectStrategy strategies[] = {
762 {enable_direct && !force_relay, direct_disabled_log, client_try_connect_direct},
763 {enable_udp_relay, "mp client: udp relay disabled",
764 static_cast<bool (*)(const protocol::LobbyStart &, const std::string &)>(
765 client_try_connect_udp_relay)},
766 {enable_tcp_relay, "mp client: tcp relay disabled",
767 static_cast<bool (*)(const protocol::LobbyStart &, const std::string &)>(
768 client_try_connect_tcp_relay)},
769 };
770
771 auto try_strategies = [&](const ConnectStrategy *begin,
772 const ConnectStrategy *end) -> bool {
773 for (const ConnectStrategy *it = begin; it != end; ++it) {
774 if (!it->enabled) {
775 if (debug_enabled() && it->disabled_log)
776 debug_log("%s", it->disabled_log);
777 continue;
778 }
779 if (it->attempt(start, host_ip))
780 return true;
781 }
782 return false;
783 };
784
785 if (try_strategies(std::begin(strategies), std::end(strategies)))
786 return true;
787
788 SessionShutdown();
789 return false;
790}
