792bool SessionBeginClientJoin(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
793 std::vector<std::string> hosts;
794 if (!host_ip.empty())
795 hosts.push_back(host_ip);
796 return SessionBeginClientJoin(start, hosts);
797}
798
799bool SessionBeginClientJoin(const protocol::LobbyStart &start,
800 const std::vector<std::string> &host_ips) {
801 if (g_session.active || g_join.active)
802 return false;
803 if (debug_enabled())
804 debug_log("mp debug enabled");
805 unsigned expected_players = std::min<unsigned>(start.expected_players, input::kMaxPlayers);
806 if (expected_players < 1)
807 return false;
808
809 reset_session_bootstrap(start, expected_players, false, false, 1);
810
811 g_join = ClientJoinState();
812 g_join.active = true;
813 g_join.start = start;
814 g_join.host_ips = host_ips;
815 g_join.cfg = multiplayer::LoadMultiplayerConfig();
816 if (debug_enabled()) {
817 std::string hosts;
818 for (size_t i = 0; i < g_join.host_ips.size(); ++i) {
819 if (i)
820 hosts += ",";
821 hosts += g_join.host_ips[i];
822 }
823 debug_log("mp client: join begin session=%u port=%u hosts=%s",
824 static_cast<unsigned>(start.session_id),
825 static_cast<unsigned>(start.host_port),
826 hosts.c_str());
827 }
828 join_build_strategy_list();
829 g_join.strategy_index = 0;
830 g_join.direct_host_index = 0;
831
832 if (!join_begin_next_attempt()) {
833 SessionShutdown();
834 g_join = ClientJoinState();
835 return false;
836 }
837 return true;
838}
839
840multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus SessionPollClientJoin() {
841 if (!g_join.active)
842 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::IDLE;
843
844 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
845
846 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING || g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME) {
847 if (tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket)) {
848 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING) {
849 fd_set wfds;
850 FD_ZERO(&wfds);
851 FD_SET(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, &wfds);
852 timeval tv;
853 tv.tv_sec = 0;
854 tv.tv_usec = 0;
855#ifdef WIN32
856 int sel = ::select(0, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
857#else
858 int sel = ::select(g_session.tcp_relay_socket + 1, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
859#endif
860 if (sel > 0) {
861 int err = 0;
862#ifdef WIN32
863 int errlen = sizeof(err);
864#else
865 socklen_t errlen = sizeof(err);
866#endif
867 if (::getsockopt(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR,
868 reinterpret_cast<char *>(&err), &errlen) == 0 &&
869 err == 0) {
870 ecl::Buffer hello;
871 encode_relay_header(hello, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, g_join.start.session_id, 0);
872 if (tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, hello.data(), hello.size()))
873 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME;
874 else
875 join_fail_current_attempt();
876 } else {
877 join_fail_current_attempt();
878 }
879 }
880 }
881
882 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME) {
883 fd_set rfds;
884 FD_ZERO(&rfds);
885 FD_SET(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, &rfds);
886 timeval tv;
887 tv.tv_sec = 0;
888 tv.tv_usec = 0;
889#ifdef WIN32
890 int sel = ::select(0, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
891#else
892 int sel = ::select(g_session.tcp_relay_socket + 1, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
893#endif
894 if (sel > 0) {
895 if (!tcp_pump_recv(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, g_session.tcp_relay_rx)) {
896 join_fail_current_attempt();
897 } else {
898 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
899 while (tcp_try_extract_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_rx,
900 g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len, frame)) {
901 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data());
902 ecl::Buffer buf;
903 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), frame.size());
904 Uint8 player_id = 0;
905 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
906 Uint32 seed = 0;
907 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed)) {
908 if (debug_enabled())
909 debug_log("mp client: welcome (tcp relay) player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
910 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id),
911 static_cast<unsigned>(expected_players),
912 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
913 g_session.local_player = player_id;
914 g_session.local_player_known = true;
915 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
916 g_session.seed = seed;
917 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
918 g_session.active_transport = TransportKind::TCP_RELAY;
919 if (debug_enabled())
920 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s",
921 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
922 g_join.active = false;
923 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::JOINED;
924 }
925 }
926 }
927 }
928 }
929 }
930
931 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_CONNECTING && now > g_join.connect_deadline) {
932 if (debug_enabled())
933 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u (tcp relay)", g_join.target_host.c_str(),
934 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port));
935 join_fail_current_attempt();
936 } else if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::TCP_WAIT_WELCOME && now > g_join.welcome_deadline) {
937 if (debug_enabled())
938 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u (tcp relay)", g_join.target_host.c_str(),
939 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port));
940 join_fail_current_attempt();
941 }
942
943 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::IDLE) {
944 if (join_begin_next_attempt())
945 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::CONNECTING;
946 SessionShutdown();
947 g_join = ClientJoinState();
948 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::FAILED;
949 }
950
951 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::CONNECTING;
952 }
953
954 ENetEvent event;
955 while (g_session.host_handle && enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, 0) > 0) {
956 if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT) {
957 g_session.server_peer = event.peer;
958 if (g_join.relay_connect) {
959 ecl::Buffer buf;
960 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, g_join.start.session_id, 0);
961 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(),
962 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
963 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
964 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
965 }
966 g_join.phase = JoinPhase::WAIT_WELCOME;
967 } else if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE) {
968 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
969 ecl::Buffer buf;
970 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), event.packet->dataLength);
971 Uint8 player_id = 0;
972 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
973 Uint32 seed = 0;
974 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed)) {
975 if (debug_enabled())
976 debug_log("mp client: welcome player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
977 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id),
978 static_cast<unsigned>(expected_players),
979 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
980 g_session.local_player = player_id;
981 g_session.local_player_known = true;
982 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
983 g_session.seed = seed;
984 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
985 g_session.active_transport =
986 g_join.relay_connect ? TransportKind::UDP_RELAY : TransportKind::DIRECT;
987 if (debug_enabled())
988 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s",
989 transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
990
991 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
992 g_join.active = false;
993 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::JOINED;
994 }
995 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
996 } else if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT) {
997 break;
998 }
999 }
1000
1001 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::CONNECTING && now > g_join.connect_deadline) {
1002 if (debug_enabled())
1003 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u", g_join.target_host.c_str(),
1004 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port));
1005 join_fail_current_attempt();
1006 } else if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::WAIT_WELCOME && now > g_join.welcome_deadline) {
1007 if (debug_enabled())
1008 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u", g_join.target_host.c_str(),
1009 static_cast<unsigned>(g_join.target_port));
1010 join_fail_current_attempt();
1011 }
1012
1013 if (g_join.phase == JoinPhase::IDLE) {
1014 if (join_begin_next_attempt())
1015 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::CONNECTING;
1016 SessionShutdown();
1017 g_join = ClientJoinState();
1018 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::FAILED;
1019 }
1020
1021 return multiplayer::ClientJoinStatus::CONNECTING;
1022}
1023
1024void SessionCancelClientJoin() {
1025 if (!g_join.active)
1026 return;
1027 join_fail_current_attempt();
1028 SessionShutdown();
1029 g_join = ClientJoinState();
1030}

A src/multiplayer_session_sync.cc

Description
  • Per-tick input synchronization and periodic world checksum verification/resync.
Where it is used

What changed vs upstream/master
  • Adds deterministic lockstep input exchange and divergence detection with soft resync.

79int64_t quantize_for_dump(double v) {
80 return static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(v * 100.0));
81}

83uint32_t stable_name_hash(Actor *actor) {
84 if (!actor)
85 return 0;
86 Value name = actor->getAttr("name");
87 if (name.getType() != Value::STRING)
88 return 0;
89 const std::string &s = name.get_string();
90 if (s.empty())
91 return 0;
92 // FNV-1a 32-bit.
93 uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
94 for (unsigned char c : s) {
95 h ^= static_cast<uint32_t>(c);
96 h *= 16777619u;
97 }
98 return h ? h : 1u;
99}

103struct ActorSortKey {
104 uint32_t name_hash = 0;
105 std::string kind;
106 Uint32 object_id = 0;
107};
108
109ActorSortKey actor_sort_key(Actor *a) {
110 ActorSortKey k;
111 k.name_hash = stable_name_hash(a);
112 k.kind = a ? a->getKind() : std::string();
113 k.object_id = a ? static_cast<Uint32>(a->getId()) : 0u;
114 return k;
115}
116
117bool actor_key_less(const ActorSortKey &a, const ActorSortKey &b) {
118 // Prefer actors with a stable authored name (e.g. meditation pearls: pearl%N).
119 // Unnamed actors sort after named ones.
120 uint32_t an = a.name_hash ? a.name_hash : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
121 uint32_t bn = b.name_hash ? b.name_hash : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
122 if (an != bn)
123 return an < bn;
124 if (a.kind != b.kind)
125 return a.kind < b.kind;
126 return a.object_id < b.object_id;
127}

202 struct Digest {
203 uint32_t kind_id = 0;
204 std::string kind;
205 uint32_t object_id = 0;
206 int owner = -1;
207 int controllers = 0;
208 int color = -1;
209 int64_t x = 0;
210 int64_t y = 0;
211 int64_t vx = 0;
212 int64_t vy = 0;
213 std::string name;
214 };
215 std::vector<Digest> digs;
216 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
217 GetActors(actors);
218 digs.reserve(actors.size());
219 for (Actor *a : actors) {
220 if (!a)
221 continue;
222 Digest d;
223 d.kind_id = static_cast<uint32_t>(get_id(a));
224 d.kind = a->getKind();
225 d.object_id = static_cast<uint32_t>(a->getId());
226 Value owner = a->getAttr("owner");
227 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
228 d.owner = static_cast<int>(owner);
229 d.controllers = a->get_controllers();
230 Value color = a->getAttr("color");
231 if (color.getType() != Value::NIL)
232 d.color = static_cast<int>(color);
233 Value name = a->getAttr("name");
234 if (name.getType() == Value::STRING)
235 d.name = name.get_string();
236 const ecl::V2 &pos = a->get_pos();
237 const ecl::V2 &vel = a->get_vel();
238 d.x = quantize_for_dump(pos[0]);
239 d.y = quantize_for_dump(pos[1]);
240 d.vx = quantize_for_dump(vel[0]);
241 d.vy = quantize_for_dump(vel[1]);
242 digs.push_back(d);
243 }
244 std::sort(digs.begin(), digs.end(), [](const Digest &a, const Digest &b) {
245 if (a.kind_id != b.kind_id)
246 return a.kind_id < b.kind_id;
247 if (a.owner != b.owner)
248 return a.owner < b.owner;
249 if (a.controllers != b.controllers)
250 return a.controllers < b.controllers;
251 if (a.color != b.color)
252 return a.color < b.color;
253 if (a.x != b.x)
254 return a.x < b.x;
255 if (a.y != b.y)
256 return a.y < b.y;
257 if (a.vx != b.vx)
258 return a.vx < b.vx;
259 if (a.vy != b.vy)
260 return a.vy < b.vy;
261 if (a.name != b.name)
262 return a.name < b.name;
263 if (a.kind != b.kind)
264 return a.kind < b.kind;
265 return a.object_id < b.object_id;
266 });
267
268 debug_log("mp dump: actors=%u", static_cast<unsigned>(digs.size()));
269 for (const auto &d : digs) {
270 debug_log("mp dump: actor kind_id=%u kind=%s obj=%u owner=%d ctrl=%d color=%d name=%s pos=%lld,%lld vel=%lld,%lld",
271 static_cast<unsigned>(d.kind_id),
272 d.kind.c_str(),
273 static_cast<unsigned>(d.object_id),
274 d.owner,
275 d.controllers,
276 d.color,
277 d.name.c_str(),
278 static_cast<long long>(d.x),
279 static_cast<long long>(d.y),
280 static_cast<long long>(d.vx),
281 static_cast<long long>(d.vy));
282 }
283}

285constexpr uint32_t kSyncProbeStrideTicks =
286 static_cast<uint32_t>(kSyncInterval / kInputTimestep + 0.5);
287
288Actor *sync_reference_actor(unsigned player, uint32_t tick) {
289 // The legacy engine defines "main actor" as the first actor in the player's
290 // actor list. For authored multi-ball levels (e.g. meditation pearls) that
291 // ordering can differ across peers even when the physical state matches,
292 // which would cause spurious position mismatches in sync packets.
293 //
294 // Pick a deterministic steerable actor controlled by this player instead.
295 //
296 // IMPORTANT: Do not use position-based ordering. When a player controls
297 // multiple marbles that can cross, "top-left" can flip between peers (or
298 // across ticks) while still being physically consistent, causing endless
299 // false "pos mismatch" reports and soft-resync churn.
300 //
301 // Also, do not always pick the same controlled actor. If the chosen probe
302 // happens to be in a "stable sink" (e.g. trapped in a hole), its position
303 // can stay identical while other controlled marbles diverge. Cycle the
304 // probe deterministically so all controlled actors eventually get sampled.
305 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
306 GetActors(actors);
307 std::vector<Actor *> candidates;
308 std::vector<ActorSortKey> keys;
309 for (Actor *a : actors) {
310 if (!a || !a->isSteerable())
311 continue;
312 if (!a->controlled_by(static_cast<int>(player)))
313 continue;
314 candidates.push_back(a);
315 keys.push_back(actor_sort_key(a));
316 }
317
318 if (!candidates.empty()) {
319 std::vector<size_t> order(candidates.size());
320 for (size_t i = 0; i < order.size(); ++i)
321 order[i] = i;
322 std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](size_t ia, size_t ib) {
323 return actor_key_less(keys[ia], keys[ib]);
324 });
325 uint32_t stride = kSyncProbeStrideTicks ? kSyncProbeStrideTicks : 1u;
326 size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>((tick / stride) % static_cast<uint32_t>(order.size()));
327 return candidates[order[idx]];
328 }
329
330 return player::GetMainActor(player);
331}

387protocol::ResyncState build_resync_state_snapshot() {
388 protocol::ResyncState state;
389 state.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
390 state.tick = input::CurrentTick();
391 state.random_state = server::RandomState;
392 state.actors.clear();
393 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
394 GetActors(actors);
395 state.actors.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(actors.size()));
396 for (Actor *actor : actors) {
397 protocol::ResyncActorState entry;
398 entry.object_id = static_cast<Uint32>(actor->getId());
399 entry.actor_id = static_cast<Uint16>(get_id(actor));
400 Value owner = actor->getAttr("owner");
401 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
402 entry.owner = static_cast<Uint16>(static_cast<int>(owner));
403 else
404 entry.owner = static_cast<Uint16>(0xFFFF);
405 entry.controllers = static_cast<Uint32>(actor->get_controllers());
406 Value color = actor->getAttr("color");
407 if (color.getType() != Value::NIL)
408 entry.color = static_cast<Uint16>(static_cast<int>(color));
409 else
410 entry.color = static_cast<Uint16>(0xFFFF);
411 entry.name_hash = stable_name_hash(actor);
412 entry.x = static_cast<float>(actor->get_pos()[0]);
413 entry.y = static_cast<float>(actor->get_pos()[1]);
414 entry.vx = static_cast<float>(actor->get_vel()[0]);
415 entry.vy = static_cast<float>(actor->get_vel()[1]);
416 state.actors.push_back(entry);
417 }
418 return state;
419}

463void apply_resync_state(const protocol::ResyncState &state) {
464 if (!g_session.active)
465 return;
466 if (state.epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
467 return;
468 g_session.telemetry.resync_responses_recv += 1;
469 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
470 uint32_t delta_ticks = (local_tick > state.tick) ? (local_tick - state.tick) : 0;
471 // Resync snapshots can arrive a few ticks late, but velocity projection is
472 // unreliable in high-acceleration physics (rubberbands, collisions) and
473 // tends to amplify post-resync divergence. Apply snapshots as-is.
474 float dt = 0.0f;
475 if (debug_enabled())
476 debug_log("mp resync recv: state tick=%u local tick=%u delta=%u actors=%u", state.tick,
477 local_tick, delta_ticks, static_cast<unsigned>(state.actors.size()));
478 server::RandomState = state.random_state;
479
480 std::unordered_map<Uint32, Actor *> by_object_id;
481 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
482 GetActors(actors);
483 by_object_id.reserve(actors.size());
484 for (Actor *actor : actors)
485 by_object_id[static_cast<Uint32>(actor->getId())] = actor;
486 std::unordered_map<Actor *, bool> used;
487 used.reserve(actors.size());
488
489 // Applying a resync snapshot must not trigger gameplay side-effects like
490 // floor/item enter/leave callbacks (which can diverge further across peers).
491 // We only update physics state and the spatial index via DidMoveActor().
492 auto resync_teleport = [](Actor *actor, float x, float y, float vx, float vy) {
493 ActorInfo *ai = actor->get_actorinfo();
494 ai->pos = ecl::V2(x, y);
495 DidMoveActor(actor);
496 ai->last_gridpos = ai->gridpos;
497 ai->vel = ecl::V2(vx, vy);
498 ai->pos_force = ai->pos;
499 ai->forceacc = ecl::V2();
500 ai->force = ecl::V2();
501 ai->collforce = ecl::V2();
502 ai->friction = 0.0;
503 ai->contacts = ai->contacts_a;
504 ai->last_contacts = ai->contacts_b;
505 ai->contacts_count = 0;
506 ai->last_contacts_count = 0;
507 };
508
509 unsigned applied = 0;
510 unsigned object_id_matches = 0;
511 float max_pos_delta = 0.0f;
512 // First, apply by object_id when possible (best fidelity).
513 for (const auto &entry : state.actors) {
514 auto it = by_object_id.find(entry.object_id);
515 if (it == by_object_id.end())
516 continue;
517 Actor *actor = it->second;
518 if (!actor || used[actor])
519 continue;
520 float x = entry.x + entry.vx * dt;
521 float y = entry.y + entry.vy * dt;
522 ActorInfo *ai = actor->get_actorinfo();
523 float dx = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[0]) - x;
524 float dy = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[1]) - y;
525 float d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
526 if (d > max_pos_delta)
527 max_pos_delta = d;
528 resync_teleport(actor, x, y, entry.vx, entry.vy);
529 apply_resync_metadata(actor, entry.owner, entry.controllers, entry.color);
530 used[actor] = true;
531 applied += 1;
532 object_id_matches += 1;
533 }
534
535 // For the remaining entries, match by (kind, owner, position) instead of
536 // object_id. This avoids fragile resync mapping in levels with multiple
537 // identical marbles (e.g. meditation) where object ids can diverge across
538 // peers due to non-deterministic scripting/creation order.
539 std::vector<uint8_t> snap_used(state.actors.size(), 0);
540 std::vector<size_t> remaining_snaps;
541 remaining_snaps.reserve(state.actors.size());
542 for (size_t i = 0; i < state.actors.size(); ++i) {
543 const auto &entry = state.actors[i];
544 auto it = by_object_id.find(entry.object_id);
545 if (it != by_object_id.end()) {
546 Actor *actor = it->second;
547 if (actor && used[actor]) {
548 snap_used[i] = 1;
549 continue;
550 }
551 }
552 remaining_snaps.push_back(i);
553 }
554
555 // Pass 0: match by stable name hash when available (best effort for scripted
556 // multi-ball levels where object ids can differ across peers).
557 if (!remaining_snaps.empty()) {
558 std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::vector<Actor *>> local_by_name;
559 local_by_name.reserve(actors.size());
560 for (Actor *a : actors) {
561 if (!a || used[a])
562 continue;
563 uint32_t nh = stable_name_hash(a);
564 if (!nh)
565 continue;
566 uint16_t kind = static_cast<uint16_t>(get_id(a));
567 uint64_t key = (static_cast<uint64_t>(kind) << 32) | static_cast<uint64_t>(nh);
568 local_by_name[key].push_back(a);
569 }
570
571 for (size_t idx : remaining_snaps) {
572 if (snap_used[idx])
573 continue;
574 const auto &s = state.actors[idx];
575 if (!s.name_hash)
576 continue;
577 uint64_t key = (static_cast<uint64_t>(s.actor_id) << 32) | static_cast<uint64_t>(s.name_hash);
578 auto it = local_by_name.find(key);
579 if (it == local_by_name.end() || it->second.empty())
580 continue;
581
582 // Choose the closest remaining actor to the snapshot position.
583 Actor *best = nullptr;
584 double best_d2 = 0.0;
585 for (Actor *cand : it->second) {
586 if (!cand || used[cand])
587 continue;
588 const ecl::V2 &p = cand->get_pos();
589 double dx = static_cast<double>(p[0]) - static_cast<double>(s.x);
590 double dy = static_cast<double>(p[1]) - static_cast<double>(s.y);
591 double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
592 if (!best || d2 < best_d2) {
593 best = cand;
594 best_d2 = d2;
595 }
596 }
597 if (!best)
598 continue;
599 float x = s.x + s.vx * dt;
600 float y = s.y + s.vy * dt;
601 ActorInfo *ai = best->get_actorinfo();
602 float dx = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[0]) - x;
603 float dy = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[1]) - y;
604 float d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
605 if (d > max_pos_delta)
606 max_pos_delta = d;
607 resync_teleport(best, x, y, s.vx, s.vy);
608 apply_resync_metadata(best, s.owner, s.controllers, s.color);
609 used[best] = true;
610 snap_used[idx] = 1;
611 applied += 1;
612 }
613
614 // Rebuild remaining_snaps to exclude those already matched by name.
615 std::vector<size_t> tmp;
616 tmp.reserve(remaining_snaps.size());
617 for (size_t idx : remaining_snaps) {
618 if (!snap_used[idx])
619 tmp.push_back(idx);
620 }
621 remaining_snaps.swap(tmp);
622 }
623
624 auto local_owner = [](Actor *a) -> int {
625 Value owner = a->getAttr("owner");
626 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
627 return static_cast<int>(owner);
628 return -1;
629 };
630
631 auto match_groups = [&](bool include_owner) -> unsigned {
632 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<size_t>> snap_groups;
633 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<Actor *>> local_groups;
634 snap_groups.reserve(remaining_snaps.size());
635 local_groups.reserve(actors.size());
636
637 auto make_key = [&](Uint16 kind, int owner) -> uint32_t {
638 if (!include_owner)
639 return static_cast<uint32_t>(kind);
640 uint32_t o = static_cast<uint32_t>(owner + 1);
641 if (o > 0xFFFFu)
642 o = 0xFFFFu;
643 return (static_cast<uint32_t>(kind) << 16) | o;
644 };
645
646 for (size_t idx : remaining_snaps) {
647 if (snap_used[idx])
648 continue;
649 const auto &s = state.actors[idx];
650 int owner = (s.owner == 0xFFFF) ? -1 : static_cast<int>(s.owner);
651 snap_groups[make_key(s.actor_id, owner)].push_back(idx);
652 }
653 for (Actor *a : actors) {
654 if (!a || used[a])
655 continue;
656 int owner = local_owner(a);
657 uint16_t kind = static_cast<uint16_t>(get_id(a));
658 local_groups[make_key(kind, owner)].push_back(a);
659 }
660
661 auto sort_snap = [&](size_t ai, size_t bi) {
662 const auto &a = state.actors[ai];
663 const auto &b = state.actors[bi];
664 if (a.x != b.x)
665 return a.x < b.x;
666 return a.y < b.y;
667 };
668 auto sort_local = [&](const Actor *a, const Actor *b) {
669 const ecl::V2 &pa = a->get_pos();
670 const ecl::V2 &pb = b->get_pos();
671 if (pa[0] != pb[0])
672 return pa[0] < pb[0];
673 return pa[1] < pb[1];
674 };
675
676 unsigned matched = 0;
677 for (auto &kv : snap_groups) {
678 auto it_local = local_groups.find(kv.first);
679 if (it_local == local_groups.end())
680 continue;
681 auto &snap_list = kv.second;
682 auto &local_list = it_local->second;
683 if (snap_list.empty() || local_list.empty())
684 continue;
685 std::sort(snap_list.begin(), snap_list.end(), sort_snap);
686 std::sort(local_list.begin(), local_list.end(), sort_local);
687 size_t n = std::min(snap_list.size(), local_list.size());
688 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
689 size_t snap_idx = snap_list[i];
690 Actor *actor = local_list[i];
691 if (!actor || used[actor] || snap_used[snap_idx])
692 continue;
693 const auto &s = state.actors[snap_idx];
694 float x = s.x + s.vx * dt;
695 float y = s.y + s.vy * dt;
696 ActorInfo *ai = actor->get_actorinfo();
697 float dx = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[0]) - x;
698 float dy = static_cast<float>(ai->pos[1]) - y;
699 float d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
700 if (d > max_pos_delta)
701 max_pos_delta = d;
702 resync_teleport(actor, x, y, s.vx, s.vy);
703 apply_resync_metadata(actor, s.owner, s.controllers, s.color);
704 used[actor] = true;
705 snap_used[snap_idx] = 1;
706 applied += 1;
707 matched += 1;
708 }
709 }
710 return matched;
711 };
712
713 unsigned matched_by_group = 0;
714 // Pass 1: match by (kind, owner) when possible.
715 matched_by_group += match_groups(true);
716 // Pass 2: match by kind only for remaining (ownerless / ambiguous) actors.
717 // Rebuild remaining_snaps to exclude those already matched.
718 if (!remaining_snaps.empty()) {
719 std::vector<size_t> tmp;
720 tmp.reserve(remaining_snaps.size());
721 for (size_t idx : remaining_snaps) {
722 if (!snap_used[idx])
723 tmp.push_back(idx);
724 }
725 remaining_snaps.swap(tmp);
726 }
727 if (!remaining_snaps.empty())
728 matched_by_group += match_groups(false);
729 // Rubberband "violation" flags can diverge across peers and then keep
730 // applying different forces even after actor positions are snapped. After
731 // teleporting, recompute these flags from the current anchor positions to
732 // reduce persistent post-resync drift in meditation levels.
733 std::vector<Rubberband *> rubbers;
734 GetRubberbands(rubbers);
735 for (Rubberband *rb : rubbers) {
736 if (!rb)
737 continue;
738 SendMessage(rb, "_mp_resync_flags");
739 }
740 if (debug_enabled())
741 debug_log("mp resync applied: actors=%u (obj_id=%u group=%u) max_pos_delta=%.3f",
742 applied, object_id_matches, matched_by_group,
743 static_cast<double>(max_pos_delta));
744 g_session.telemetry.resync_applied += 1;
745
746 // Mark the resync response as received. Do NOT reset attempts here: if the
747 // resync does not actually fix the divergence, resetting attempts would
748 // cause endless "jumpy" re-resync loops and prevent reaching the "failed
749 // resync" user-facing warning.
750 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
751 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
752 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
753 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
754 record_checksum_sample();
755}

815bool host_ready_to_start() {
816 if (!g_session.host)
817 return false;
818 if (g_session.expected_players <= 1)
819 return true;
820 if (g_session.peer_players.size() + g_session.relay_players.size() +
821 g_session.tcp_relay_players.size() + 1 <
822 g_session.expected_players) {
823 return false;
824 }
825 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players) {
826 auto it = g_session.peer_ready.find(entry.first);
827 if (it == g_session.peer_ready.end() || !it->second)
828 return false;
829 }
830 for (const auto &entry : g_session.relay_players) {
831 auto it = g_session.relay_ready.find(entry.first);
832 if (it == g_session.relay_ready.end() || !it->second)
833 return false;
834 }
835 for (const auto &entry : g_session.tcp_relay_players) {
836 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_ready.find(entry.first);
837 if (it == g_session.tcp_relay_ready.end() || !it->second)
838 return false;
839 }
840 if (g_session.expected_players > g_session.level_players && g_session.level_players > 0) {
841 if (g_session.placement_received.size() < g_session.expected_players)
842 return false;
843 for (unsigned player = g_session.level_players; player < g_session.expected_players;
844 ++player) {
845 if (!g_session.placement_received[player])
846 return false;
847 }
848 }
849 return true;
850}

857 }
858 }
859 return false;

861
862void handle_sync_current(const protocol::SyncPacket &sync) {
863 if (g_session.abort_pending)
864 return;
865 if (sync.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
866 debug_log("mp sync skip: epoch=%u local epoch=%u", sync.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
867 return;
868 }
869 g_session.telemetry.sync_current_total += 1;
870 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
871 if (sync.tick != local_tick) {
872 debug_log("mp sync skip: sync tick=%u local tick=%u", sync.tick, local_tick);
873 return;
874 }
875 uint64_t local_checksum = WorldChecksum();
876 update_checksum_sample_world(local_tick, local_checksum);
877 g_session.last_world_checksum = local_checksum;
878 bool checksum_mismatch =
879 (sync.world_checksum != 0 && sync.world_checksum != local_checksum);
880 if (checksum_mismatch) {
881 debug_log("mp checksum mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu", sync.tick,
882 static_cast<unsigned long long>(local_checksum),
883 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.world_checksum));
884 }
885 uint64_t local_actor_checksum = ActorChecksum();
886 bool actor_mismatch =
887 (sync.actor_checksum != 0 && sync.actor_checksum != local_actor_checksum);
888 if (actor_mismatch) {
889 debug_log("mp actor mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu", sync.tick,
890 static_cast<unsigned long long>(local_actor_checksum),
891 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.actor_checksum));
892 }
893 Actor *p0 = sync_reference_actor(0, sync.tick);
894 Actor *p1 = sync_reference_actor(1, sync.tick);
895 float p0_x = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
896 float p0_y = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
897 float p1_x = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
898 float p1_y = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
899
900 auto diff = [](float a, float b) { return fabs(a - b); };
901 bool rand_mismatch = sync.random_state != server::RandomState;
902 bool pos_mismatch = diff(sync.p0_x, p0_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
903 diff(sync.p0_y, p0_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
904 diff(sync.p1_x, p1_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
905 diff(sync.p1_y, p1_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon;
906 if (pos_mismatch)
907 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_pos += 1;
908 if (rand_mismatch)
909 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_rand += 1;
910 if (actor_mismatch)
911 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_actor += 1;
912 if (checksum_mismatch)
913 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_world += 1;
914
915 const bool rng_only =
916 (!pos_mismatch && rand_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch);
917 const bool diagnostic_only =
918 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && (checksum_mismatch || actor_mismatch));
919 const bool soft_resync_candidate = (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch);
920 const bool actor_resync_candidate =
921 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && actor_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch);
922 const bool world_only_mismatch =
923 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch);
924 if (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch || actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch) {
925 if (rng_only)
926 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_rng_only += 1;
927 if (diagnostic_only)
928 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_diagnostic_only += 1;
929 if (soft_resync_candidate)
930 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_soft_resync_candidate += 1;
931
932 const char *action =
933 rng_only ? "rng-fix"
934 : soft_resync_candidate ? "soft-resync"
935 : actor_resync_candidate ? "actor-resync"
936 : diagnostic_only ? "diagnostic-only"
937 : "none";
938 debug_log("mp desync: tick=%u rand local=%u remote=%u "
939 "flags(pos=%d rand=%d actor=%d world=%d) action=%s "
940 "p0(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f) p1(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f)",
941 sync.tick, static_cast<unsigned>(server::RandomState),
942 static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state),
943 pos_mismatch ? 1 : 0, rand_mismatch ? 1 : 0, actor_mismatch ? 1 : 0,
944 checksum_mismatch ? 1 : 0, action,
945 p0_x, p0_y, sync.p0_x, sync.p0_y,
946 p1_x, p1_y, sync.p1_x, sync.p1_y);
947 if (actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch)
948 dump_actor_digest_once("sync_current_mismatch", sync.tick, &sync);
949 if (rng_only) {
950 server::RandomState = sync.random_state;
951 g_session.telemetry.rng_resync_applied += 1;
952 debug_log("mp rng resynced to %u", static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state));
953 return;
954 }
955 }
956
957 // Actor/world checksums can diverge due to harmless platform floating-point
958 // drift in physics-heavy levels. Drive recovery from position/RNG mismatch,
959 // and keep checksums for diagnostics only.
960 if (world_only_mismatch) {
961 g_session.world_only_desync_streak += 1;
962 if (g_session.world_only_desync_streak >= 3 && !g_session.desync_reported) {
963 g_session.desync_reported = true;
964 client::Msg_ShowText("World desync detected. Please restart.", true, 4.0);
965 }
966 } else {
967 g_session.world_only_desync_streak = 0;
968 }
969 if (soft_resync_candidate) {
970 g_session.actor_desync_streak = 0;
971 g_session.desync_streak += 1;
972 if (g_session.desync_streak < kDesyncStreakForResync)
973 return;
974 if (g_session.resync_attempts < kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.resync_inflight &&
975 g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
976 send_resync_request();
977 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
978 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
979 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
980 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
981 }
982 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts) {
983 // Resync did not quickly converge. Keep running without prompting a restart:
984 // most of these cases are physics drift that can self-heal or improve over time.
985 // Throttle further requests instead of permanently giving up.
986 g_session.telemetry.resync_giveups += 1;
987 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
988 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
989 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
990 g_session.resync_cooldown = std::max(g_session.resync_cooldown, 3.0);
991 }
992 } else if (actor_resync_candidate) {
993 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
994 g_session.actor_desync_streak += 1;
995 if (g_session.actor_desync_streak < kActorDesyncStreakForResync)
996 return;
997 if (g_session.resync_attempts < kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.resync_inflight &&
998 g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
999 send_resync_request();
1000 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1001 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1002 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1003 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1004 }
1005 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts) {
1006 g_session.telemetry.resync_giveups += 1;
1007 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1008 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1009 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1010 g_session.resync_cooldown = std::max(g_session.resync_cooldown, 3.0);
1011 }
1012 } else {
1013 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1014 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1015 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1016 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
1017 g_session.actor_desync_streak = 0;
1018 g_session.world_only_desync_streak = 0;
1019 }
1020}
1021
1022void handle_sync_sample(const protocol::SyncPacket &sync,
1023 const SessionState::ChecksumSample &sample) {
1024 if (g_session.abort_pending)
1025 return;
1026 if (sync.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
1027 debug_log("mp sync skip: epoch=%u local epoch=%u", sync.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
1028 return;
1029 }
1030 g_session.telemetry.sync_sample_total += 1;
1031 bool checksum_mismatch = false;
1032 if (sample.world_valid && sync.world_checksum != 0)
1033 checksum_mismatch = sync.world_checksum != sample.world_checksum;
1034 bool actor_mismatch = (sync.actor_checksum != 0 && sync.actor_checksum != sample.actor_checksum);
1035 bool rand_mismatch = sync.random_state != sample.random_state;
1036 auto diff = [](float a, float b) { return fabs(a - b); };
1037 bool pos_mismatch = diff(sync.p0_x, sample.p0_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1038 diff(sync.p0_y, sample.p0_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1039 diff(sync.p1_x, sample.p1_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1040 diff(sync.p1_y, sample.p1_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon;
1041 if (pos_mismatch)
1042 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_pos += 1;
1043 if (rand_mismatch)
1044 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_rand += 1;
1045 if (actor_mismatch)
1046 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_actor += 1;
1047 if (checksum_mismatch)
1048 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_world += 1;
1049
1050 const bool rng_only =
1051 (!pos_mismatch && rand_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch);
1052 const bool diagnostic_only =
1053 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && (checksum_mismatch || actor_mismatch));
1054 const bool soft_resync_candidate = (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch);
1055 const bool actor_resync_candidate =
1056 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && actor_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch);
1057 const bool world_only_mismatch =
1058 (!pos_mismatch && !rand_mismatch && checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch);
1059
1060 if (checksum_mismatch) {
1061 debug_log("mp checksum mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu",
1062 sync.tick,
1063 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sample.world_checksum),
1064 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.world_checksum));
1065 }
1066 if (actor_mismatch) {
1067 debug_log("mp actor mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu",
1068 sync.tick,
1069 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sample.actor_checksum),
1070 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.actor_checksum));
1071 }
1072 if (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch || actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch) {
1073 if (rng_only)
1074 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_rng_only += 1;
1075 if (diagnostic_only)
1076 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_diagnostic_only += 1;
1077 if (soft_resync_candidate)
1078 g_session.telemetry.mismatch_soft_resync_candidate += 1;
1079
1080 const char *action =
1081 rng_only ? "rng-fix"
1082 : soft_resync_candidate ? "soft-resync"
1083 : actor_resync_candidate ? "actor-resync"
1084 : diagnostic_only ? "diagnostic-only"
1085 : "none";
1086 debug_log("mp desync (late): tick=%u rand local=%u remote=%u "
1087 "flags(pos=%d rand=%d actor=%d world=%d) action=%s "
1088 "p0(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f) p1(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f)",
1089 sync.tick,
1090 static_cast<unsigned>(sample.random_state),
1091 static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state),
1092 pos_mismatch ? 1 : 0, rand_mismatch ? 1 : 0, actor_mismatch ? 1 : 0,
1093 checksum_mismatch ? 1 : 0, action,
1094 sample.p0_x, sample.p0_y, sync.p0_x, sync.p0_y,
1095 sample.p1_x, sample.p1_y, sync.p1_x, sync.p1_y);
1096 if (actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch)
1097 dump_actor_digest_once("sync_sample_mismatch", sync.tick, &sync);
1098 }
1099
1100 // Actor checksums are useful diagnostics but too sensitive to drive recovery
1101 // on their own, especially in physics-heavy scenes.
1102 if (world_only_mismatch) {
1103 g_session.world_only_desync_streak += 1;
1104 if (g_session.world_only_desync_streak >= 3 && !g_session.desync_reported) {
1105 g_session.desync_reported = true;
1106 client::Msg_ShowText("World desync detected. Please restart.", true, 4.0);
1107 }
1108 } else {
1109 g_session.world_only_desync_streak = 0;
1110 }
1111 if (soft_resync_candidate) {
1112 g_session.actor_desync_streak = 0;
1113 g_session.desync_streak += 1;
1114 if (g_session.desync_streak < kDesyncStreakForResync)
1115 return;
1116 if (g_session.resync_attempts < kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.resync_inflight &&
1117 g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1118 send_resync_request();
1119 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1120 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1121 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1122 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1123 }
1124 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts) {
1125 g_session.telemetry.resync_giveups += 1;
1126 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1127 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1128 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1129 g_session.resync_cooldown = std::max(g_session.resync_cooldown, 3.0);
1130 }
1131 } else if (actor_resync_candidate) {
1132 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
1133 g_session.actor_desync_streak += 1;
1134 if (g_session.actor_desync_streak < kActorDesyncStreakForResync)
1135 return;
1136 if (g_session.resync_attempts < kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.resync_inflight &&
1137 g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1138 send_resync_request();
1139 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1140 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1141 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1142 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1143 }
1144 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts) {
1145 g_session.telemetry.resync_giveups += 1;
1146 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1147 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1148 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1149 g_session.resync_cooldown = std::max(g_session.resync_cooldown, 3.0);
1150 }
1151 } else {
1152 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1153 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1154 g_session.resync_inflight_timer = 0.0;
1155 g_session.desync_streak = 0;
1156 g_session.actor_desync_streak = 0;
1157 g_session.world_only_desync_streak = 0;
1158 }
1159}

1161void record_checksum_sample() {
1162 uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
1163 g_session.last_checksum_tick = tick;
1164 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
1165 sample.tick = tick;
1166 sample.actor_checksum = ActorChecksum();
1167 sample.world_checksum = 0;
1168 sample.world_valid = false;
1169 sample.random_state = server::RandomState;
1170 Actor *p0 = sync_reference_actor(0, tick);
1171 Actor *p1 = sync_reference_actor(1, tick);
1172 sample.p0_x = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1173 sample.p0_y = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1174 sample.p1_x = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1175 sample.p1_y = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1176 if (!g_session.checksum_history.empty() && g_session.checksum_history.back().tick == tick) {
1177 bool preserve_world = g_session.checksum_history.back().world_valid;
1178 uint64_t preserved_checksum = g_session.checksum_history.back().world_checksum;
1179 g_session.checksum_history.back() = sample;
1180 if (preserve_world) {
1181 g_session.checksum_history.back().world_valid = true;
1182 g_session.checksum_history.back().world_checksum = preserved_checksum;
1183 }
1184 return;
1185 }
1186 g_session.checksum_history.push_back(sample);
1187 while (g_session.checksum_history.size() > kChecksumHistory)
1188 g_session.checksum_history.pop_front();
1189}

A src/multiplayer_session_transport.cc

Description
  • Session transport plumbing: packet IO, polling, and shutdown behavior.
Where it is used
  • Used by session tick to exchange per-tick input and control messages.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • Ensures abort/shutdown stops transport polling immediately to avoid use-after-free and UI stalls.

89bool lookup_remote_player(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer, Uint32 relay_client_id,
90 unsigned &player_id) {
91 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
92 auto it = g_session.relay_players.find(relay_client_id);
93 if (it != g_session.relay_players.end()) {
94 player_id = it->second;
95 return true;
96 }
97 return false;
98 }
99 if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
100 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_players.find(relay_client_id);
101 if (it != g_session.tcp_relay_players.end()) {
102 player_id = it->second;
103 return true;
104 }
105 return false;
106 }
107 auto it = g_session.peer_players.find(peer);
108 if (it != g_session.peer_players.end()) {
109 player_id = it->second;
110 return true;
111 }
112 return false;
113}

115void mark_remote_ready(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer, Uint32 relay_client_id) {
116 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY)
117 g_session.relay_ready[relay_client_id] = true;
118 else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY)
119 g_session.tcp_relay_ready[relay_client_id] = true;
120 else
121 g_session.peer_ready[peer] = true;
122}

124void send_input_to_peer(ENetPeer *peer, const protocol::InputPacket &pkt) {
125 ecl::Buffer buf;
126 protocol::encode_input(buf, pkt);
127 g_transport.HostSendDirect(peer, buf);
128}
129
130void broadcast_input(const protocol::InputPacket &pkt, ENetPeer *exclude, Uint32 exclude_udp_relay,
131 Uint32 exclude_tcp_relay) {
132 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players) {
133 if (entry.first == exclude)
134 continue;
135 send_input_to_peer(entry.first, pkt);
136 }
137 ecl::Buffer buf;
138 protocol::encode_input(buf, pkt);
139 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
140 g_transport.HostBroadcastUdpRelay(buf, exclude_udp_relay);
141 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
142 g_transport.HostBroadcastTcpRelay(buf, exclude_tcp_relay);
143}

145bool handle_host_input_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
146 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
147 ecl::Buffer buf;
148 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
149 protocol::InputPacket input_msg;
150 if (!protocol::decode_input(buf, input_msg))
151 return false;
152 if (input_msg.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
153 debug_log("mp drop input: tick=%u epoch=%u local epoch=%u", input_msg.tick, input_msg.epoch,
154 g_session.input_epoch);
155 return true;
156 }
157 if (input_msg.tick < 20) {
158 debug_log("mp recv input: tick=%u player=%u mouse=(%.2f,%.2f) rot=%d act=%u",
159 input_msg.tick, input_msg.player, input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y,
160 static_cast<int>(input_msg.rotate_steps),
161 static_cast<unsigned>(input_msg.activate_count));
162 }
163 if (input_msg.tick < input::CurrentTick())
164 return true;
165 unsigned player_id = 0;
166 if (!lookup_remote_player(source, peer, relay_client_id, player_id))
167 return true;
168 input::PlayerInput pi;
169 pi.mouse_force = ecl::V2(input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y);
170 pi.rotate_steps = input_msg.rotate_steps;
171 pi.activate_count = input_msg.activate_count;
172 input::EnqueueInput(input_msg.tick, player_id, pi);
173 protocol::InputPacket forward = input_msg;
174 forward.player = static_cast<Uint8>(player_id);
175 broadcast_input(forward, source == HostSource::DIRECT ? peer : nullptr,
176 source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY ? relay_client_id : 0,
177 source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY ? relay_client_id : 0);
178 return true;
179}
180
181bool handle_host_resync_request_packet(const char *data, size_t len, HostSource source,
182 Uint32 relay_client_id, ENetPeer *peer) {
183 ecl::Buffer buf;
184 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
185 protocol::ResyncRequest req;
186 if (!protocol::decode_resync_request(buf, req))
187 return false;
188 if (req.epoch == g_session.input_epoch) {
189 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY)
190 send_resync_state_to_relay(relay_client_id);
191 else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY)
192 send_resync_state_to_tcp_relay(relay_client_id);
193 else
194 send_resync_state(peer);
195 }
196 return true;
197}

199bool handle_host_ready_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
200 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
201 ecl::Buffer buf;
202 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
203 if (!protocol::decode_ready(buf))
204 return false;
205 unsigned player_id = 0;
206 if (lookup_remote_player(source, peer, relay_client_id, player_id)) {
207 debug_log("mp host: ready player=%u source=%s", player_id, host_source_name(source));
208 mark_remote_ready(source, peer, relay_client_id);
209 debug_log("mp host: peer ready");
210 }
211 return true;
212}

214bool handle_host_pause_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
215 ecl::Buffer buf;
216 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
217 Uint32 epoch = 0;
218 bool paused = false;
219 if (!protocol::decode_pause(buf, epoch, paused))
220 return false;
221 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
222 return true;
223 SessionRequestPause(paused);
224 return true;
225}

227bool handle_host_menu_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
228 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
229 ecl::Buffer buf;
230 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
231 Uint32 epoch = 0;
232 Uint8 ignored_player = 0;
233 bool open = false;
234 if (!protocol::decode_menu(buf, epoch, ignored_player, open))
235 return false;
236 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
237 return true;
238 unsigned player_id = 0;
239 if (!lookup_remote_player(source, peer, relay_client_id, player_id))
240 return true;
241 if (player_id >= g_session.menu_open.size())
242 return true;
243 if (g_session.menu_open[player_id] == open)
244 return true;
245 g_session.menu_open[player_id] = open;
246
247 bool want_pause = false;
248 for (bool any : g_session.menu_open) {
249 if (any) {
250 want_pause = true;
251 break;
252 }
253 }
254 SessionRequestPause(want_pause);
255 return true;
256}
257
258bool handle_host_abort_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
259 ecl::Buffer buf;
260 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
261 Uint32 epoch = 0;
262 if (!protocol::decode_abort(buf, epoch))
263 return false;
264 if (epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
265 return true;
266 // Abort is global: one player aborts => end the session for all.
267 send_abort_to_peers();
268 begin_abort_after_grace("Game aborted. Ending session.");
269 return true;
270}

272bool handle_host_placement_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
273 ecl::Buffer buf;
274 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
275 protocol::PlacementPacket place;
276 if (!protocol::decode_place(buf, place))
277 return false;
278 if (place.restart_id == g_session.restart_id && place.player < g_session.expected_players) {
279 GridPos pos(static_cast<int>(place.x), static_cast<int>(place.y));
280 if (placement_required_for_player(place.player) && is_valid_placement(pos, place.player)) {
281 apply_placement(place.player, pos);
282 if (g_session.placement_received.size() > place.player)
283 g_session.placement_received[place.player] = true;
284 broadcast_placement(place);
285 }
286 }
287 return true;
288}

290bool handle_host_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer, HostSource source,
291 Uint32 relay_client_id) {
292 if (handle_host_input_packet(data, len, peer, source, relay_client_id))
293 return true;
294 if (handle_host_resync_request_packet(data, len, source, relay_client_id, peer))
295 return true;
296 if (handle_host_ready_packet(data, len, peer, source, relay_client_id))
297 return true;
298 if (handle_host_menu_packet(data, len, peer, source, relay_client_id))
299 return true;
300 if (handle_host_pause_packet(data, len))
301 return true;
302 if (handle_host_abort_packet(data, len))
303 return true;
304 if (handle_host_placement_packet(data, len))
305 return true;
306 return false;
307}

336bool handle_client_welcome_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
337 ecl::Buffer buf;
338 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
339 Uint8 player_id = 0;
340 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
341 Uint32 seed = 0;
342 if (!protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed))
343 return false;
344 g_session.local_player = player_id;
345 g_session.local_player_known = true;
346 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
347 g_session.seed = seed;
348 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
349 debug_log("mp client: welcome player=%u expected=%u seed=%u", player_id, expected_players, seed);
350 if (debug_enabled())
351 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s", transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
352 if (g_session.phase == SessionState::Phase::WAITING_FOR_READY && !g_session.local_ready_sent) {
353 send_ready_to_host();
354 g_session.local_ready_sent = true;
355 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
356 }
357 return true;
358}

360bool handle_client_sync_packet(const char *data, size_t len) {
361 if (g_session.abort_pending)
362 return true;
363 ecl::Buffer buf;
364 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
365 protocol::SyncPacket sync;
366 if (!protocol::decode_sync(buf, sync))
367 return false;
368 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
369 if (local_tick < sync.tick) {
370 g_session.pending_sync = sync;
371 g_session.has_pending_sync = true;
372 } else if (local_tick == sync.tick) {
373 handle_sync_current(sync);
374 } else {
375 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
376 if (lookup_checksum_sample(sync.tick, sample)) {
377 handle_sync_sample(sync, sample);
378 } else {
379 debug_log("mp sync skip: sync tick=%u local tick=%u (no history)", sync.tick,
380 local_tick);
381 }
382 }
383 return true;
384}

467void handle_client_payload(const char *data, size_t len) {
468 if (handle_client_input_packet(data, len))
469 return;
470 if (handle_client_welcome_packet(data, len))
471 return;
472 if (handle_client_sync_packet(data, len))
473 return;
474 if (handle_client_resync_state_packet(data, len))
475 return;
476 if (handle_client_start_packet(data, len))
477 return;
478 if (handle_client_pause_packet(data, len))
479 return;
480 if (handle_client_abort_packet(data, len))
481 return;
482 if (handle_client_restart_packet(data, len))
483 return;
484 handle_client_placement_packet(data, len);
485}

506bool host_register_relay_client(Uint32 client_id, HostSource source) {
507 if (!can_accept_more_remote_players())
508 return false;
509
510 unsigned player_id = g_session.next_player_id++;
511 ecl::Buffer welcome;
512 protocol::encode_welcome(welcome, static_cast<Uint8>(player_id),
513 static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.expected_players), g_session.seed);
514
515 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
516 g_session.relay_players[client_id] = player_id;
517 g_session.relay_ready[client_id] = false;
518 debug_log("mp host: relay client -> player %u", player_id);
519 g_transport.HostSendUdpRelay(client_id, welcome);
520 send_existing_placements_to_relay(client_id);
521 return true;
522 }
523
524 if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
525 g_session.tcp_relay_players[client_id] = player_id;
526 g_session.tcp_relay_ready[client_id] = false;
527 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay client -> player %u", player_id);
528 g_transport.HostSendTcpRelay(client_id, welcome);
529 send_existing_placements_to_tcp_relay(client_id);
530 return true;
531 }
532
533 return false;
534}
535
536bool host_unregister_relay_client(Uint32 client_id, HostSource source) {
537 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
538 g_session.relay_players.erase(client_id);
539 g_session.relay_ready.erase(client_id);
540 } else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
541 g_session.tcp_relay_players.erase(client_id);
542 g_session.tcp_relay_ready.erase(client_id);
543 } else {
544 return true;
545 }
546 if (g_session.active)
547 return abort_session_with_message("Player disconnected. Ending session.");
548 return true;
549}
550
551bool handle_direct_connect_event(ENetPeer *peer) {
552 if (!g_session.host)
553 return true;
554 if (!can_accept_more_remote_players()) {
555 enet_peer_disconnect(peer, 0);
556 return true;
557 }
558
559 unsigned player_id = g_session.next_player_id++;
560 g_session.peer_players[peer] = player_id;
561 g_session.peer_ready[peer] = false;
562 peer->data = reinterpret_cast<void *>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(player_id));
563 debug_log("mp host: peer connected -> player %u", player_id);
564
565 ecl::Buffer buf;
566 protocol::encode_welcome(buf, static_cast<Uint8>(player_id),
567 static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.expected_players), g_session.seed);
568 g_transport.HostSendDirect(peer, buf);
569 send_existing_placements_to_peer(peer);
570 return true;
571}
572
573bool handle_relay_payload_as_host(const char *data, size_t len, HostSource source,
574 bool close_on_decode_error, bool (*on_connect)(Uint32),
575 bool (*on_disconnect)(Uint32)) {
576 RelayMessageType type = RELAY_ERROR;
577 Uint32 session_id = 0;
578 Uint32 client_id = 0;
579 const char *payload = nullptr;
580 size_t payload_len = 0;
581 if (!decode_relay_header(data, len, type, session_id, client_id, payload, payload_len)) {
582 if (close_on_decode_error)
583 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
584 return true;
585 }
586 if (session_id != g_session.session_id)
587 return true;
588 if (type == RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT) {
589 return on_connect(client_id);
590 }
591 if (type == RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT)
592 return on_disconnect(client_id);
593 if (type == RELAY_DATA) {
594 // Propagate abort/disconnect requests back to the poll loop.
595 if (!handle_host_packet(payload, payload_len, nullptr, source, client_id))
596 return false;
597 }
598 return true;
599}
600
601bool handle_udp_relay_payload(const char *data, size_t len) {
602 return handle_relay_payload_as_host(data, len, HostSource::UDP_RELAY, false,
603 host_register_udp_relay_client,
604 host_unregister_udp_relay_client);
605}
606
607bool handle_tcp_relay_payload(const char *data, size_t len) {
608 if (!g_session.host) {
609 if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY)
610 handle_client_payload(data, len);
611 // The client can receive a session-ending message (e.g. NET_ABORT) via relay.
612 // If that happens, stop polling immediately because SessionShutdown may have
613 // destroyed sockets/ENet hosts still being serviced by the transport loop.
614 if (!g_session.active)
615 return false;
616 return true;
617 }
618 return handle_relay_payload_as_host(data, len, HostSource::TCP_RELAY, true,
619 host_register_tcp_relay_client,
620 host_unregister_tcp_relay_client);
621}

623} // namespace

625void process_network_events() {
626 if (!g_session.active)
627 return;
628 // Poll all active transports via one facade.
629 class Sink : public ITransportSink {
630 public:
631 bool OnConnect(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer) override {
632 if (source != HostSource::DIRECT)
633 return true;
634 return handle_direct_connect_event(peer);
635 }
636 bool OnDisconnect(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer) override {
637 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
638 if (g_session.relay_peer == peer) {
639 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
640 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
641 return abort_session_with_message("Relay disconnected. Ending session.");
642 }
643 return true;
644 }
645 if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
646 if (g_session.host) {
647 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
648 return abort_session_with_message("TCP relay disconnected. Ending session.");
649 return true;
650 }
651 if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY)
652 return abort_session_with_message("Disconnected from TCP relay.");
653 return true;
654 }
655 return handle_direct_disconnect_event(peer);
656 }
657 bool OnPayload(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer, const char *data, size_t len) override {
658 // Any packet counts as progress (avoid false "host disconnected" aborts).
659 g_session.no_payload_timer = 0.0;
660 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
661 return handle_udp_relay_payload(data, len);
662 }
663 if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
664 return handle_tcp_relay_payload(data, len);
665 }
666 return handle_direct_payload(peer, data, len);
667 }
668 private:
669 bool handle_direct_payload(ENetPeer *peer, const char *data, size_t len) {
670 if (g_session.host)
671 return handle_host_packet(data, len, peer, HostSource::DIRECT, 0);
672 if (g_session.active_transport != TransportKind::TCP_RELAY)
673 handle_client_payload(data, len);
674 if (!g_session.active)
675 return false;
676 return true;
677 }
678 bool handle_direct_disconnect_event(ENetPeer *peer) {
679 return handle_direct_disconnect_event_impl(peer);
680 }
681 static bool handle_direct_disconnect_event_impl(ENetPeer *peer) {
682 if (g_session.host) {
683 g_session.peer_players.erase(peer);
684 g_session.peer_ready.erase(peer);
685 if (g_session.active)
686 return abort_session_with_message("Player disconnected. Ending session.");
687 return true;
688 }
689 return abort_session_with_message("Disconnected from host.");
690 }
691 };
692
693 Sink sink;
694 g_transport.Poll(sink);
695}

697void send_local_inputs() {
698 if (!g_session.active || !g_session.local_player_known)
699 return;
700 uint32_t current_tick = input::CurrentTick();
701 uint32_t delay = g_session.input_delay ? g_session.input_delay : kInputDelay;
702 uint32_t target_tick = current_tick + delay;
703 if (g_session.input_clock_tick > current_tick) {
704 uint32_t extra = g_session.input_clock_tick - current_tick;
705 if (extra > kMaxInputLead)
706 extra = kMaxInputLead;
707 target_tick += extra;
708 }
709 input::PlayerInput pending = input::DrainLocalPending(g_session.local_player);
710 bool applied = false;
711 bool sent_packets = false;
712
713 while (g_session.next_local_tick <= target_tick) {
714 input::PlayerInput send = applied ? input::PlayerInput() : pending;
715 if (!send.empty()) {
716 float fx = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[0]);
717 float fy = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[1]);
718 send.mouse_force = ecl::V2(fx, fy);
719 }
720 protocol::InputPacket pkt;
721 pkt.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
722 pkt.tick = g_session.next_local_tick;
723 pkt.player = static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.local_player);
724 pkt.mouse_x = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[0]);
725 pkt.mouse_y = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[1]);
726 pkt.rotate_steps = static_cast<int16_t>(send.rotate_steps);
727 pkt.activate_count = static_cast<Uint8>(send.activate_count);
728
729 input::EnqueueInput(pkt.tick, g_session.local_player, send);
730 g_session.local_history[pkt.tick] = send;
731 applied = true;
732 ++g_session.next_local_tick;
733 }
734
735 if (g_session.host) {
736 if (!has_remote_peers())
737 return;
738 } else if (!g_session.server_peer) {
739 if (!(g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY &&
740 tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket))) {
741 return;
742 }
743 }
744
745 uint32_t send_tick = g_session.next_send_tick;
746 if (send_tick < current_tick)
747 send_tick = current_tick;
748 while (send_tick < g_session.next_local_tick) {
749 protocol::InputPacket pkt;
750 pkt.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
751 pkt.tick = send_tick;
752 pkt.player = static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.local_player);
753 auto it = g_session.local_history.find(pkt.tick);
754 if (it != g_session.local_history.end()) {
755 const input::PlayerInput &queued = it->second;
756 pkt.mouse_x = static_cast<float>(queued.mouse_force[0]);
757 pkt.mouse_y = static_cast<float>(queued.mouse_force[1]);
758 pkt.rotate_steps = static_cast<int16_t>(queued.rotate_steps);
759 pkt.activate_count = static_cast<Uint8>(queued.activate_count);
760 g_session.local_history.erase(it);
761 } else {
762 pkt.mouse_x = 0.0f;
763 pkt.mouse_y = 0.0f;
764 pkt.rotate_steps = 0;
765 pkt.activate_count = 0;
766 }
767 if (pkt.tick < 20) {
768 debug_log("mp send input: tick=%u player=%u mouse=(%.2f,%.2f) rot=%d act=%u",
769 pkt.tick, pkt.player, pkt.mouse_x, pkt.mouse_y,
770 static_cast<int>(pkt.rotate_steps),
771 static_cast<unsigned>(pkt.activate_count));
772 }
773 if (g_session.host)
774 broadcast_input(pkt, nullptr, 0, 0);
775 else {
776 ecl::Buffer payload;
777 protocol::encode_input(payload, pkt);
778 g_transport.ClientSend(payload);
779 }
780 sent_packets = true;
781 ++send_tick;
782 }
783 g_session.next_send_tick = send_tick;
784
785 if (sent_packets)
786 g_transport.Flush();
787}

789} // namespace internal
790} // namespace multiplayer

37/* -------------------- Multiplayer TCP socket -------------------- */
38/*
39 * Small TCP socket helpers used by the TCP relay transport.
40 *
41 * Isolated from session code to avoid platform socket ifdef noise elsewhere.
42 */
43
44namespace enigma {
45namespace multiplayer {
46namespace internal {
47
48bool tcp_socket_valid(TcpSocket s) {
49#ifdef WIN32
50 return s != INVALID_SOCKET;
51#else
52 return s >= 0;
53#endif
54}
55
56void tcp_close(TcpSocket &s) {
57 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
58 return;
59#ifdef WIN32
60 closesocket(s);
61 s = INVALID_SOCKET;
62#else
63 close(s);
64 s = -1;
65#endif
66}
67
68bool tcp_set_nonblocking(TcpSocket s) {
69#ifdef WIN32
70 u_long mode = 1;
71 return ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &mode) == 0;
72#else
73 int flags = fcntl(s, F_GETFL, 0);
74 if (flags < 0)
75 return false;
76 return fcntl(s, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK) == 0;
77#endif
78}
79
80static bool tcp_send_all(TcpSocket s, const void *data, size_t len) {
81 const uint8_t *p = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(data);
82 size_t sent = 0;
83 while (sent < len) {
84#ifdef WIN32
85 int n = ::send(s, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(p + sent),
86 static_cast<int>(len - sent), 0);
87#else
88 ssize_t n = ::send(s, p + sent, len - sent, 0);
89#endif
90 if (n <= 0) {
91#ifdef WIN32
92 int err = WSAGetLastError();
93 if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK) {
94 if (debug_enabled())
95 debug_log("mp tcp send failed err=%d", err);
96 return false;
97 }
98#else
99 if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK) {
100 if (debug_enabled())
101 debug_log("mp tcp send failed errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
102 return false;
103 }
104#endif
105 fd_set wfds;
106 FD_ZERO(&wfds);
107 FD_SET(s, &wfds);
108 timeval tv;
109 tv.tv_sec = 0;
110 tv.tv_usec = 200 * 1000;
111#ifdef WIN32
112 int sel = ::select(0, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
113#else
114 int sel = ::select(s + 1, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
115#endif
116 if (sel <= 0) {
117 if (debug_enabled())
118 debug_log("mp tcp send wait timeout/err sel=%d", sel);
119 return false;
120 }
121 continue;
122 }
123 sent += static_cast<size_t>(n);
124 }
125 return true;
126}
127
128bool tcp_send_frame(TcpSocket s, const void *data, size_t len) {
129 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
130 return false;
131 if (len > (1u << 20))
132 return false;
133 uint8_t prefix[4];
134 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(len);
135 prefix[0] = static_cast<uint8_t>(v & 0xFF);
136 prefix[1] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
137 prefix[2] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
138 prefix[3] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
139 return tcp_send_all(s, prefix, sizeof(prefix)) && tcp_send_all(s, data, len);
140}
141
142bool tcp_pump_recv(TcpSocket s, std::vector<uint8_t> &rx) {
143 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
144 return false;
145 uint8_t buf[4096];
146 while (true) {
147#ifdef WIN32
148 int n = ::recv(s, reinterpret_cast<char *>(buf), static_cast<int>(sizeof(buf)), 0);
149 if (n == 0)
150 return false;
151 if (n < 0) {
152 int err = WSAGetLastError();
153 if (err == WSAEWOULDBLOCK)
154 break;
155 return false;
156 }
157#else
158 ssize_t n = ::recv(s, buf, sizeof(buf), 0);
159 if (n == 0)
160 return false;
161 if (n < 0) {
162 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
163 break;
164 return false;
165 }
166#endif
167 rx.insert(rx.end(), buf, buf + n);
168 if (static_cast<size_t>(n) < sizeof(buf))
169 break;
170 }
171 return true;
172}
173
174bool tcp_try_extract_frame(std::vector<uint8_t> &rx, uint32_t &pending_len,
175 std::vector<uint8_t> &out) {
176 out.clear();
177 if (pending_len == 0) {
178 if (rx.size() < 4)
179 return false;
180 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[0]) |
181 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[1]) << 8) |
182 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[2]) << 16) |
183 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[3]) << 24);
184 rx.erase(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + 4);
185 if (v == 0 || v > (1u << 20)) {
186 pending_len = 0;
187 rx.clear();
188 return false;
189 }
190 pending_len = v;
191 }
192 if (rx.size() < pending_len)
193 return false;
194 out.assign(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + pending_len);
195 rx.erase(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + pending_len);
196 pending_len = 0;
197 return true;
198}
199
200bool tcp_connect_timeout(const std::string &host, Uint16 port, Uint32 timeout_ms,
201 TcpSocket &out) {
202 out = kInvalidTcpSocket;
203 if (host.empty() || port == 0)
204 return false;
205 addrinfo hints;
206 ::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
207 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
208 hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
209
210 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
211 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(port));
212 if (getaddrinfo(host.c_str(), port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0)
213 return false;
214
215 Uint32 start = SDL_GetTicks();
216 for (addrinfo *ai = res; ai != nullptr; ai = ai->ai_next) {
217 if (SDL_GetTicks() - start > timeout_ms)
218 break;
219 TcpSocket s = ::socket(ai->ai_family, ai->ai_socktype, ai->ai_protocol);
220 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
221 continue;
222 if (!tcp_set_nonblocking(s)) {
223 tcp_close(s);
224 continue;
225 }
226 int rc = ::connect(s, ai->ai_addr, static_cast<int>(ai->ai_addrlen));
227#ifdef WIN32
228 if (rc == 0) {
229 out = s;
230 freeaddrinfo(res);
231 return true;
232 }
233 int err = WSAGetLastError();
234 if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK && err != WSAEINPROGRESS) {
235 tcp_close(s);
236 continue;
237 }
238#else
239 if (rc == 0) {
240 out = s;
241 freeaddrinfo(res);
242 return true;
243 }
244 if (errno != EINPROGRESS) {
245 tcp_close(s);
246 continue;
247 }
248#endif
249 fd_set wfds;
250 FD_ZERO(&wfds);
251 FD_SET(s, &wfds);
252 timeval tv;
253 tv.tv_sec = static_cast<long>(timeout_ms / 1000);
254 tv.tv_usec = static_cast<long>((timeout_ms % 1000) * 1000);
255#ifdef WIN32
256 int sel = ::select(0, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
257#else
258 int sel = ::select(s + 1, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
259#endif
260 if (sel > 0) {
261 out = s;
262 freeaddrinfo(res);
263 return true;
264 }
265 tcp_close(s);
266 }
267
268 freeaddrinfo(res);
269 return false;
270}

272} // namespace internal
273} // namespace multiplayer
274} // namespace enigma

23/* -------------------- Multiplayer transport -------------------- */
24/*
25 * Transport implementation.
26 *
27 * Contains low-level polling and send paths for direct ENet, UDP relay, and TCP
28 * relay links.

31namespace enigma {

35Transport g_transport;
36
37namespace {
38
39bool poll_direct_enet(ITransportSink &sink) {
40 // Direct ENet sessions (host or client). TCP-relay-only clients don't have a host_handle.
41 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr)
42 return true;
43
44 ENetEvent event;
45 while (enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, 0) > 0) {
46 switch (event.type) {
47 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT:
48 if (!sink.OnConnect(HostSource::DIRECT, event.peer))
49 return false;
50 break;
51 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
52 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
53 bool ok = sink.OnPayload(HostSource::DIRECT, event.peer, data,
54 event.packet->dataLength);
55 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
56 if (!ok)
57 return false;
58 break;
59 }
60 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT:
61 if (!sink.OnDisconnect(HostSource::DIRECT, event.peer))
62 return false;
63 break;
64 default:
65 break;
66 }
67 }
68 return true;
69}
70
71bool poll_udp_relay(ITransportSink &sink) {
72 // Only the host polls a dedicated ENet host for relay connection. Clients use host_handle.
73 if (!g_session.host || g_session.relay_handle == nullptr)
74 return true;
75
76 ENetEvent event;
77 while (enet_host_service(g_session.relay_handle, &event, 0) > 0) {
78 switch (event.type) {
79 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
80 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
81 bool ok = sink.OnPayload(HostSource::UDP_RELAY, event.peer, data,
82 event.packet->dataLength);
83 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
84 if (!ok)
85 return false;
86 break;
87 }
88 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT:
89 if (!sink.OnDisconnect(HostSource::UDP_RELAY, event.peer))
90 return false;
91 break;
92 default:
93 break;
94 }
95 }
96 return true;
97}
98
99bool poll_tcp_relay(ITransportSink &sink) {
100 if (!tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket))
101 return true;
102
103 if (!tcp_pump_recv(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, g_session.tcp_relay_rx)) {
104 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
105 return sink.OnDisconnect(HostSource::TCP_RELAY, nullptr);
106 }
107
108 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
109 while (tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket) &&
110 tcp_try_extract_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_rx, g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len, frame)) {
111 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data());
112 if (!sink.OnPayload(HostSource::TCP_RELAY, nullptr, data, frame.size()))
113 return false;
114 }
115 return true;
116}
117
118} // namespace
119
120bool Transport::Poll(ITransportSink &sink) {
121 if (!poll_direct_enet(sink))
122 return false;
123 if (!poll_udp_relay(sink))
124 return false;
125 return poll_tcp_relay(sink);
126}
127
128bool Transport::ClientSend(const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
129 if (g_session.host)
130 return false;
131 if (g_session.server_peer) {
132 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(),
133 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
134 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
135 Flush();
136 return true;
137 }
138 if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY &&
139 tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket)) {
140 bool ok = tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, payload.data(), payload.size());
141 if (!ok && debug_enabled())
142 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay send failed (len=%u)", (unsigned)payload.size());
143 return ok;
144 }
145 return false;
146}
147
148void Transport::HostSendDirect(ENetPeer *peer, const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
149 if (!peer)
150 return;
151 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
152 enet_peer_send(peer, 0, packet);
153}
154
155void Transport::HostSendUdpRelay(Uint32 client_id, const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
156 if (!g_session.relay_peer)
157 return;
158 ecl::Buffer buf;
159 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_SEND, g_session.session_id, client_id);
160 buf.write(payload.data(), payload.size());
161 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
162 enet_peer_send(g_session.relay_peer, 0, packet);
163 if (g_session.relay_handle)
164 enet_host_flush(g_session.relay_handle);
165}
166
167void Transport::HostSendTcpRelay(Uint32 client_id, const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
168 if (!tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket))
169 return;
170 ecl::Buffer buf;
171 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_SEND, g_session.session_id, client_id);
172 buf.write(payload.data(), payload.size());
173 tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, buf.data(), buf.size());
174}
175
176void Transport::HostBroadcastUdpRelay(const ecl::Buffer &payload, Uint32 exclude_client_id) {
177 for (const auto &entry : g_session.relay_players) {
178 if (entry.first == exclude_client_id)
179 continue;
180 HostSendUdpRelay(entry.first, payload);
181 }
182}
183
184void Transport::HostBroadcastTcpRelay(const ecl::Buffer &payload, Uint32 exclude_client_id) {
185 for (const auto &entry : g_session.tcp_relay_players) {
186 if (entry.first == exclude_client_id)
187 continue;
188 HostSendTcpRelay(entry.first, payload);
189 }
190}
191
192void Transport::HostBroadcast(const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
193 if (!g_session.host)
194 return;
195 if (g_session.peer_players.empty() && g_session.relay_players.empty() &&
196 g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty()) {
197 return;
198 }
199 if (!g_session.peer_players.empty()) {
200 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
201 enet_host_broadcast(g_session.host_handle, 0, packet);
202 }
203 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
204 HostBroadcastUdpRelay(payload, 0);
205 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
206 HostBroadcastTcpRelay(payload, 0);
207}
208
209void Transport::Flush() {
210 if (g_session.host_handle)
211 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
212}
213
214} // namespace internal
215} // namespace multiplayer
216} // namespace enigma

22/* -------------------- Multiplayer transport -------------------- */
23/*
24 * Transport abstraction for multiplayer sessions.
25 *
26 * The session engine interacts with one send/recv/poll surface regardless of
27 * whether peers connect directly or via relays.
28 */
29
30#include "multiplayer_internal.hh"
31
32namespace enigma {
33namespace multiplayer {
34namespace internal {
35
36class ITransportSink {
37public:
38 virtual ~ITransportSink() = default;
39
40 virtual bool OnConnect(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer) = 0;
41 virtual bool OnDisconnect(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer) = 0;
42 virtual bool OnPayload(HostSource source, ENetPeer *peer, const char *data, size_t len) = 0;
43};
44
45// Session transport facade.
46//
47// This centralizes polling/sending across:
48// - direct ENet client<->host (LAN)
49// - UDP ENet relay host<->relay and client<->relay
50// - TCP relay framing for both host and clients
51//
52// Session logic provides an ITransportSink and stays agnostic to the underlying transport.
53class Transport {
54public:
55 bool Poll(ITransportSink &sink);
56
57 // Client side: sends raw game payload to the currently active host link.
58 bool ClientSend(const ecl::Buffer &payload);
59
60 // Host side: sends raw game payload to a specific remote.
61 void HostSendDirect(ENetPeer *peer, const ecl::Buffer &payload);
62 void HostSendUdpRelay(Uint32 client_id, const ecl::Buffer &payload);
63 void HostSendTcpRelay(Uint32 client_id, const ecl::Buffer &payload);
64
65 // Host side: broadcast raw game payload to all remotes.
66 void HostBroadcast(const ecl::Buffer &payload);
67 void HostBroadcastUdpRelay(const ecl::Buffer &payload, Uint32 exclude_client_id);
68 void HostBroadcastTcpRelay(const ecl::Buffer &payload, Uint32 exclude_client_id);
69
70 // Flush ENet outbound queues (safe to call even if not connected).
71 void Flush();
72};
73
74extern Transport g_transport;
75
76} // namespace internal
77} // namespace multiplayer
78} // namespace enigma
79
80#endif

32bool parse_host_port(const std::string &value, std::string &host, Uint16 &port,
33 Uint16 default_port) {
34 host.clear();
35 port = default_port;
36 if (value.empty())
37 return false;
38 std::string::size_type pos = value.rfind(':');
39 if (pos == std::string::npos) {
40 host = value;
41 } else {
42 host = value.substr(0, pos);
43 std::string port_str = value.substr(pos + 1);
44 if (!port_str.empty()) {
45 char *end = nullptr;
46 long parsed = std::strtol(port_str.c_str(), &end, 10);
47 if (end && *end == '\0' && parsed > 0 && parsed <= 65535)
48 port = static_cast<Uint16>(parsed);
49 }
50 }
51
52 if (host == "localhost" || host == "::1")
53 host = "127.0.0.1";
54 return !host.empty();
55}

2290constexpr uint64_t kChecksumOffset = 1469598103934665603ull;
2291constexpr uint64_t kChecksumPrime = 1099511628211ull;
2292
2293void hash_bytes(uint64_t &h, const void *data, size_t len) {
2294 const unsigned char *ptr = static_cast<const unsigned char *>(data);
2295 for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
2296 h ^= static_cast<uint64_t>(ptr[i]);
2297 h *= kChecksumPrime;
2298 }
2299}
2300
2301void hash_u64(uint64_t &h, uint64_t v) {
2302 hash_bytes(h, &v, sizeof(v));
2303}
2304
2305void hash_i64(uint64_t &h, int64_t v) {
2306 hash_bytes(h, &v, sizeof(v));
2307}
2308
2309void hash_string(uint64_t &h, const std::string &s) {
2310 if (!s.empty())
2311 hash_bytes(h, s.data(), s.size());
2312 unsigned char sep = 0;
2313 hash_bytes(h, &sep, 1);
2314}
2315
2316int64_t quantize(double v) {
2317 // Multiplayer uses WorldChecksum/ActorChecksum for desync detection. Keep
2318 // quantization coarse enough to avoid false positives due to tiny platform-
2319 // dependent floating point drift, but fine enough to catch real divergence.
2320 // 0.05 tiles ~= 1/20th of a cell.
2321 return static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(v * 20.0));
2322}
2323
2324void hash_object_state(uint64_t &h, Object *obj) {
2325 if (!obj) {
2326 hash_u64(h, 0);
2327 return;
2328 }
2329 hash_string(h, obj->getKind());
2330 Value state = obj->getAttr("state");
2331 if (!state.isDefault()) {
2332 int state_value = static_cast<int>(state);
2333 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(state_value));
2334 } else {
2335 hash_u64(h, 0);
2336 }
2337}
2338
2339} // namespace

2341uint64_t WorldChecksum() {
2342 if (!level)
2343 return 0;
2344 uint64_t h = kChecksumOffset;
2345 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->w));
2346 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(level->h));
2347
2348 for (int y = 0; y < level->h; ++y) {
2349 for (int x = 0; x < level->w; ++x) {
2350 GridPos p(x, y);
2351 hash_object_state(h, level->fl_layer.get(p));
2352 hash_object_state(h, level->st_layer.get(p));
2353 hash_object_state(h, level->it_layer.get(p));
2354 }
2355 }
