2357 struct ActorDigest {
2358 uint32_t kind = 0;
2359 uint32_t id = 0;
2360 int owner = -1;
2361 int controllers = 0;
2362 int64_t x = 0;
2363 int64_t y = 0;
2364 int64_t vx = 0;
2365 int64_t vy = 0;
2366 };
2367 std::vector<ActorDigest> actors;
2368 actors.reserve(level->actorlist.size());
2369 for (Actor *actor : level->actorlist) {
2370 ActorDigest d;
2371 d.kind = static_cast<uint32_t>(get_id(actor));
2372 d.id = static_cast<uint32_t>(actor->getId());
2373 Value owner = actor->getAttr("owner");
2374 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
2375 d.owner = static_cast<int>(owner);
2376 d.controllers = actor->get_controllers();
2377 const ecl::V2 &pos = actor->get_pos();
2378 const ecl::V2 &vel = actor->get_vel();
2379 d.x = quantize(pos[0]);
2380 d.y = quantize(pos[1]);
2381 d.vx = quantize(vel[0]);
2382 d.vy = quantize(vel[1]);
2383 actors.push_back(d);
2384 }
2385 std::sort(actors.begin(), actors.end(), [](const ActorDigest &a, const ActorDigest &b) {
2386 if (a.kind != b.kind)
2387 return a.kind < b.kind;
2388 if (a.id != b.id)
2389 return a.id < b.id;
2390 if (a.owner != b.owner)
2391 return a.owner < b.owner;
2392 if (a.controllers != b.controllers)
2393 return a.controllers < b.controllers;
2394 if (a.x != b.x)
2395 return a.x < b.x;
2396 if (a.y != b.y)
2397 return a.y < b.y;
2398 if (a.vx != b.vx)
2399 return a.vx < b.vx;
2400 return a.vy < b.vy;
2401 });
2402 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(actors.size()));
2403 for (const auto &d : actors) {
2404 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(d.kind));
2405 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(d.id));
2406 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(d.owner));
2407 hash_i64(h, static_cast<int64_t>(d.controllers));
2408 hash_i64(h, d.x);
2409 hash_i64(h, d.y);
2410 hash_i64(h, d.vx);
2411 hash_i64(h, d.vy);
2412 }
2413
2414 std::vector<Other *> others(level->others.begin(), level->others.end());
2415 std::sort(others.begin(), others.end(),
2416 [](const Other *a, const Other *b) { return a->getId() < b->getId(); });
2417 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(others.size()));
2418 for (Other *other : others) {
2419 hash_u64(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(other->getId()));
2420 hash_string(h, other->getKind());
2421 }
2422
2423 return h;
2424}

A tools/docker-entrypoint.sh

Description
  • Entrypoint script that starts the lobby server and both relay servers inside the container.
Where it is used
  • Used by the `Dockerfile` container image.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New helper for deploying the multiplayer backend as one container process tree.
diff --git a/tools/docker-entrypoint.sh b/tools/docker-entrypoint.sh
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..5a3b6eb0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/docker-entrypoint.sh

1#!/usr/bin/env bash
2set -euo pipefail
3
4LOBBY_HOST="${LOBBY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
5LOBBY_PORT="${LOBBY_PORT:-12347}"
6RELAY_HOST="${RELAY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
7RELAY_PORT="${RELAY_PORT:-12348}"
8TCP_RELAY_HOST="${TCP_RELAY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
9TCP_RELAY_PORT="${TCP_RELAY_PORT:-12349}"
10
11echo "Starting lobby server on ${LOBBY_HOST}:${LOBBY_PORT}"
12python3 -u /opt/enigma/tools/internet_lobby_server.py --host "$LOBBY_HOST" --port "$LOBBY_PORT" &
13lobby_pid=$!
14
15echo "Starting relay server on ${RELAY_HOST}:${RELAY_PORT}"
16/usr/local/bin/enigma-relay "$RELAY_HOST" "$RELAY_PORT" &
17relay_pid=$!
18
19echo "Starting TCP relay server on ${TCP_RELAY_HOST}:${TCP_RELAY_PORT}"
20/usr/local/bin/enigma-tcp-relay "$TCP_RELAY_HOST" "$TCP_RELAY_PORT" &
21tcp_relay_pid=$!
22
23trap 'kill $lobby_pid $relay_pid $tcp_relay_pid' SIGINT SIGTERM
24
25wait -n "$lobby_pid" "$relay_pid" "$tcp_relay_pid"

A tools/internet_lobby_server.py

Description
  • Internet lobby service (custom UDP protocol) used for room creation/joining and for distributing session metadata.
  • This server coordinates who is in a room; it is not on the per-tick gameplay data path.
Where it is used
  • Clients in Internet mode talk to this service to create/join/leave rooms and discover peers/transport options.
  • Deployed alongside the relays for Internet play.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New optional Internet coordination service for multiplayer.

@@ -0,0 +1,329 @@
1#!/usr/bin/env python3
2import argparse
3import random
4import socket
5import struct
6import time
7
8MAGIC = 0x52494E45 # "ENIR" little-endian
9VERSION = 1
10
11INET_CREATE = 1
12INET_JOIN = 2
13INET_LEAVE = 3
14INET_START = 4
15INET_POLL = 5
16INET_CREATE_OK = 101
17INET_JOIN_OK = 102
18INET_POLL_OK = 103
19INET_START_OK = 104
20INET_ERROR = 105
21
22
23def read_u8(data, offset):
24 if offset + 1 > len(data):
25 raise ValueError("short buffer")
26 return data[offset], offset + 1
27
28
29def read_u16(data, offset):
30 if offset + 2 > len(data):
31 raise ValueError("short buffer")
32 return struct.unpack_from("<H", data, offset)[0], offset + 2
33
34
35def read_u32(data, offset):
36 if offset + 4 > len(data):
37 raise ValueError("short buffer")
38 return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, offset)[0], offset + 4
39
40
41def read_str(data, offset):
42 length, offset = read_u16(data, offset)
43 if offset + length > len(data):
44 raise ValueError("short buffer")
45 value = data[offset:offset + length].decode("utf-8", "ignore")
46 return value, offset + length
47
48
49def write_u8(value):
50 return struct.pack("<B", value)
51
52
53def write_u16(value):
54 return struct.pack("<H", value)
55
56
57def write_u32(value):
58 return struct.pack("<I", value)
59
60
61def write_str(value):
62 raw = value.encode("utf-8")
63 return write_u16(len(raw)) + raw
64
65
66def make_code():
67 alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
68 return "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(4))
69
70
71class Room:
72 def __init__(self, code, host_ip, host_port, start, host_id):
73 self.code = code
74 self.host_ip = host_ip
75 self.host_port = host_port
76 self.start = start
77 self.created_at = time.time()
78 self.last_seen = self.created_at
79 self.members = {host_id}
80 self.started = False
81
82 def expired(self, ttl):
83 return (time.time() - self.last_seen) > ttl
84
85
86def parse_start(payload):
87 # Layout A: session_id, seed, expected, host_port, filter, level_id, host_id
88 offset = 0
89 try:
90 session_id, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
91 seed, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
92 expected_players, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
93 host_port, offset = read_u16(payload, offset)
94 filter_optimized, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
95 level_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
96 host_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
97 pack_name = ""
98 if offset < len(payload):
99 pack_name, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
100 return {
101 "session_id": session_id,
102 "seed": seed,
103 "expected_players": expected_players,
104 "host_port": host_port,
105 "filter_optimized": filter_optimized,
106 "level_id": level_id,
107 "host_id": host_id,
108 "pack_name": pack_name,
109 }
110 except Exception:
111 pass
112
113 # Layout B: optional lobby magic + session_id, level_id, seed, expected, host_port, host_id, filter
114 offset = 0
115 magic, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
116 if magic == 0x454E4C42: # "ENLB"
117 _version, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
118 _type, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
119 else:
120 offset = 0
121 magic = None
122
123 session_id, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
124 level_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
125 seed, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
126 expected_players, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
127 host_port, offset = read_u16(payload, offset)
128 host_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
129 filter_optimized = 1
130 if offset < len(payload):
131 filter_optimized, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
132 pack_name = ""
133 if offset < len(payload):
134 pack_name, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
135 return {
136 "session_id": session_id,
137 "seed": seed,
138 "expected_players": expected_players,
139 "host_port": host_port,
140 "filter_optimized": filter_optimized,
141 "level_id": level_id,
142 "host_id": host_id,
143 "pack_name": pack_name,
144 }
145
146
147def build_start(start):
148 return (
149 write_u32(start["session_id"])
150 + write_str(start["level_id"])
151 + write_u32(start["seed"])
152 + write_u8(start["expected_players"])
153 + write_u16(start["host_port"])
154 + write_str(start["host_id"])
155 + write_u8(start["filter_optimized"])
156 )
157
158
159def handle_request(data, addr, rooms, ttl):
160 offset = 0
161 magic, offset = read_u32(data, offset)
162 version, offset = read_u8(data, offset)
163 msg_type, offset = read_u8(data, offset)
164 if magic != MAGIC or version != VERSION:
165 return None
166
167 if msg_type == INET_CREATE:
168 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
169 if not code:
170 return (
171 write_u32(MAGIC)
172 + write_u8(VERSION)
173 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
174 + write_str("please choose room code")
175 )
176 if code in rooms and not rooms[code].expired(ttl):
177 return (
178 write_u32(MAGIC)
179 + write_u8(VERSION)
180 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
181 + write_str("room code is already used")
182 )
183 start = parse_start(data[offset:])
184 rooms[code] = Room(code, addr[0], start["host_port"], start, start["host_id"])
185 resp = (
186 write_u32(MAGIC)
187 + write_u8(VERSION)
188 + write_u8(INET_CREATE_OK)
189 + write_str(code)
190 + write_str(addr[0])
191 )
192 return resp
193
194 if msg_type == INET_JOIN:
195 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
196 _client_id, offset = read_str(data, offset)
197 room = rooms.get(code)
198 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
199 rooms.pop(code, None)
200 return (
201 write_u32(MAGIC)
202 + write_u8(VERSION)
203 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
204 + write_str("Room not found.")
205 )
206 room.members.add(_client_id)
207 room.last_seen = time.time()
208 resp = (
209 write_u32(MAGIC)
210 + write_u8(VERSION)
211 + write_u8(INET_JOIN_OK)
212 + build_start(room.start)
213 + write_str(room.host_ip)
214 + write_u8(len(room.members))
215 + write_str(room.start.get("pack_name", ""))
216 )
217 return resp
218
219 if msg_type == INET_START:
220 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
221 room = rooms.get(code)
222 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
223 rooms.pop(code, None)
224 return (
225 write_u32(MAGIC)
226 + write_u8(VERSION)
227 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
228 + write_str("Room not found.")
229 )
230 start = parse_start(data[offset:])
231 room.start = start
232 room.host_ip = addr[0]
233 room.host_port = start["host_port"]
234 room.started = True
235 room.last_seen = time.time()
236 return (
237 write_u32(MAGIC)
238 + write_u8(VERSION)
239 + write_u8(INET_START_OK)
240 )
241
242 if msg_type == INET_POLL:
243 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
244 room = rooms.get(code)
245 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
246 rooms.pop(code, None)
247 return (
248 write_u32(MAGIC)
249 + write_u8(VERSION)
250 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
251 + write_str("Room not found.")
252 )
253 room.last_seen = time.time()
254 if not room.started:
255 return (
256 write_u32(MAGIC)
257 + write_u8(VERSION)
258 + write_u8(INET_POLL_OK)
259 + write_u8(0)
260 + write_u8(len(room.members))
261 )
262 return (
263 write_u32(MAGIC)
264 + write_u8(VERSION)
265 + write_u8(INET_POLL_OK)
266 + write_u8(1)
267 + write_u8(len(room.members))
268 + build_start(room.start)
269 + write_str(room.host_ip)
270 + write_str(room.start.get("pack_name", ""))
271 )
272
273 if msg_type == INET_LEAVE:
274 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
275 client_id, offset = read_str(data, offset)
276 room = rooms.get(code)
277 if room:
278 room.members.discard(client_id)
279 room.last_seen = time.time()
280 if not room.members:
281 rooms.pop(code, None)
282 return (
283 write_u32(MAGIC)
284 + write_u8(VERSION)
285 + write_u8(INET_CREATE_OK)
286 + write_str(code)
287 + write_str("")
288 )
289
290 return None
291
292
293def main():
294 parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
295 parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
296 parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=12347)
297 parser.add_argument("--ttl", type=int, default=1800, help="room TTL in seconds")
298 args = parser.parse_args()
299
300 sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
301 sock.bind((args.host, args.port))
302 sock.settimeout(1.0)
303
304 rooms = {}
305 print(f"Lobby server listening on {args.host}:{args.port}")
306 while True:
307 try:
308 data, addr = sock.recvfrom(2048)
309 except socket.timeout:
310 # cleanup
311 expired = [code for code, room in rooms.items() if room.expired(args.ttl)]
312 for code in expired:
313 rooms.pop(code, None)
314 continue
315 try:
316 response = handle_request(data, addr, rooms, args.ttl)
317 except Exception:
318 response = (
319 write_u32(MAGIC)
320 + write_u8(VERSION)
321 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
322 + write_str("Bad request.")
323 )
324 if response:
325 sock.sendto(response, addr)
326
327
328if __name__ == "__main__":
329 main()

A tools/relay_server.cc

Description
  • UDP relay server used as a fallback gameplay transport when direct UDP connectivity fails.
Where it is used
  • Used in Internet mode when direct connect fails or is disabled.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New backend component: UDP relay for gameplay packets.
diff --git a/tools/relay_server.cc b/tools/relay_server.cc
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..ffcf0dbc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/relay_server.cc
@@ -0,0 +1,288 @@
1#include <enet/enet.h>
2
3#include <cstdint>
4#include <cstdlib>
5#include <cstdio>
6#include <string>
7#include <unordered_map>
8#include <vector>
9
10namespace {
11
12#ifdef ENET_VERSION
13#if ENET_VERSION >= ENET_VERSION_CREATE(1, 3, 0)
14#define ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
15#endif
16#endif
17
18constexpr uint32_t kRelayMagic = 0x4C524E45; // "ENRL"
19constexpr uint8_t kRelayVersion = 1;
20constexpr size_t kRelayHeaderSize = 4 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 4;
21
22enum RelayType : uint8_t {
23 RELAY_HELLO_HOST = 1,
24 RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT = 2,
25 RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT = 3,
26 RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT = 4,
27 RELAY_SEND = 5,
28 RELAY_DATA = 6,
29 RELAY_ERROR = 7
30};
31
32struct RelayHeader {
33 uint8_t type = 0;
34 uint32_t session_id = 0;
35 uint32_t client_id = 0;
36};
37
38struct PeerInfo {
39 enum Role { UNKNOWN, HOST, CLIENT } role = UNKNOWN;
40 uint32_t session_id = 0;
41 uint32_t client_id = 0;
42};
43
44struct RelaySession {
45 ENetPeer *host = nullptr;
46 uint32_t next_client_id = 1;
47 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, ENetPeer *> clients;
48};
49
50bool read_u8(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint8_t &out) {
51 if (offset + 1 > size)
52 return false;
53 out = data[offset++];
54 return true;
55}
56
57bool read_u32(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint32_t &out) {
58 if (offset + 4 > size)
59 return false;
60 out = static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset]) |
61 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 1]) << 8) |
62 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 2]) << 16) |
63 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 3]) << 24);
64 offset += 4;
65 return true;
66}
67
68void write_u32(std::vector<uint8_t> &out, uint32_t value) {
69 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(value & 0xFF));
70 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 8) & 0xFF));
71 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 16) & 0xFF));
72 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 24) & 0xFF));
73}
74
75bool parse_relay_header(const ENetPacket *packet, RelayHeader &out,
76 const uint8_t **payload, size_t *payload_len) {
77 const auto *data = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(packet->data);
78 size_t size = packet->dataLength;
79 size_t offset = 0;
80 uint32_t magic = 0;
81 uint8_t version = 0;
82 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, magic))
83 return false;
84 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, version))
85 return false;
86 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, out.type))
87 return false;
88 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.session_id))
89 return false;
90 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.client_id))
91 return false;
92 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
93 return false;
94 if (payload) {
95 *payload = data + offset;
96 }
97 if (payload_len) {
98 *payload_len = (offset <= size) ? (size - offset) : 0;
99 }
100 return true;
101}
102
103ENetPacket *make_relay_packet(uint8_t type, uint32_t session_id, uint32_t client_id,
104 const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len,
105 enet_uint32 flags) {
106 std::vector<uint8_t> data;
107 data.reserve(kRelayHeaderSize + payload_len);
108 write_u32(data, kRelayMagic);
109 data.push_back(kRelayVersion);
110 data.push_back(type);
111 write_u32(data, session_id);
112 write_u32(data, client_id);
113 if (payload && payload_len > 0) {
114 data.insert(data.end(), payload, payload + payload_len);
115 }
116 return enet_packet_create(data.data(), data.size(), flags);
117}
118
119} // namespace
120
121int main(int argc, char **argv) {
122 if (enet_initialize() != 0) {
123 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize ENet\n");
124 return 1;
125 }
126 atexit(enet_deinitialize);
127 std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
128 std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
129
130 const char *host_str = "0.0.0.0";
131 uint16_t port = 12348;
132 if (argc > 1)
133 host_str = argv[1];
134 if (argc > 2)
135 port = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::strtoul(argv[2], nullptr, 10));
136
137 ENetAddress address;
138 enet_address_set_host(&address, host_str);
139 address.port = port;
140 ENetHost *server = enet_host_create(&address, 64,
141#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
142 2 /* channels */,
143#endif
144 0, 0);
145 if (!server) {
146 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to create relay server on %s:%u\n", host_str, port);
147 return 1;
148 }
149
150 std::unordered_map<ENetPeer *, PeerInfo> peers;
151 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, RelaySession> sessions;
152
153 std::printf("Relay server listening on %s:%u\n", host_str, port);
154
155 while (true) {
156 ENetEvent event;
157 while (enet_host_service(server, &event, 1) > 0) {
158 switch (event.type) {
159 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT: {
160 peers[event.peer] = PeerInfo();
161 break;
162 }
163 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
164 auto info_it = peers.find(event.peer);
165 if (info_it == peers.end()) {
166 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
167 break;
168 }
169 PeerInfo &info = info_it->second;
170 if (info.role == PeerInfo::UNKNOWN) {
171 RelayHeader header;
172 if (!parse_relay_header(event.packet, header, nullptr, nullptr)) {
173 enet_peer_disconnect(event.peer, 0);
174 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
175 break;
176 }
177 if (header.type == RELAY_HELLO_HOST) {
178 info.role = PeerInfo::HOST;
179 info.session_id = header.session_id;
180 auto &session = sessions[header.session_id];
181 if (session.host && session.host != event.peer)
182 enet_peer_disconnect(session.host, 0);
183 session.host = event.peer;
184 for (const auto &entry : session.clients) {
185 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT,
186 header.session_id,
187 entry.first, nullptr, 0,
188 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
189 enet_peer_send(session.host, 0, packet);
190 }
191 } else if (header.type == RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT) {
192 info.role = PeerInfo::CLIENT;
193 info.session_id = header.session_id;
194 auto &session = sessions[header.session_id];
195 uint32_t client_id = session.next_client_id++;
196 info.client_id = client_id;
197 session.clients[client_id] = event.peer;
198 if (session.host) {
199 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT,
200 header.session_id,
201 client_id, nullptr, 0,
202 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
203 enet_peer_send(session.host, 0, packet);
204 }
205 } else {
206 enet_peer_disconnect(event.peer, 0);
207 }
208 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
209 break;
210 }
211 if (info.role == PeerInfo::CLIENT) {
212 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
213 if (session_it != sessions.end() && session_it->second.host) {
214 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_DATA,
215 info.session_id,
216 info.client_id,
217 static_cast<const uint8_t *>(event.packet->data),
218 event.packet->dataLength,
219 event.packet->flags);
220 enet_peer_send(session_it->second.host, 0, packet);
221 }
222 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
223 break;
224 }
225 if (info.role == PeerInfo::HOST) {
226 RelayHeader header;
227 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
228 size_t payload_len = 0;
229 if (!parse_relay_header(event.packet, header, &payload, &payload_len)) {
230 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
231 break;
232 }
233 if (header.type == RELAY_SEND) {
234 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
235 if (session_it != sessions.end()) {
236 auto client_it = session_it->second.clients.find(header.client_id);
237 if (client_it != session_it->second.clients.end()) {
238 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload, payload_len,
239 event.packet->flags);
240 enet_peer_send(client_it->second, 0, packet);
241 }
242 }
243 }
244 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
245 break;
246 }
247 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
248 break;
249 }
250 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT: {
251 auto info_it = peers.find(event.peer);
252 if (info_it == peers.end())
253 break;
254 PeerInfo info = info_it->second;
255 peers.erase(info_it);
256 if (info.role == PeerInfo::HOST) {
257 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
258 if (session_it != sessions.end() && session_it->second.host == event.peer) {
259 for (const auto &entry : session_it->second.clients)
260 enet_peer_disconnect(entry.second, 0);
261 sessions.erase(session_it);
262 }
263 } else if (info.role == PeerInfo::CLIENT) {
264 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
265 if (session_it != sessions.end()) {
266 session_it->second.clients.erase(info.client_id);
267 if (session_it->second.host) {
268 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT,
269 info.session_id,
270 info.client_id, nullptr, 0,
271 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
272 enet_peer_send(session_it->second.host, 0, packet);
273 }
274 if (!session_it->second.host && session_it->second.clients.empty())
275 sessions.erase(session_it);
276 }
277 }
278 break;
279 }
280 default:
281 break;
282 }
283 }
284 }
285
286 enet_host_destroy(server);
287 return 0;
288}

A tools/tcp_relay_server.cc

Description
  • TCP relay server used as a last-resort gameplay transport for networks that block UDP.
Where it is used
  • Used in Internet mode when both direct connect and UDP relay fail/are disabled.
What changed vs upstream/master
  • New backend component: TCP relay fallback for restrictive networks.

35/* -------------------- TCP relay server -------------------- */
36/*
37 * Simple TCP relay server for Enigma multiplayer.
38 *
39 * Provides a fallback transport for networks that block UDP or relayed UDP.
40 */
41
42namespace {
43constexpr uint32_t kRelayMagic = 0x4C524E45; // "ENRL"
44constexpr uint8_t kRelayVersion = 1;
45constexpr uint32_t kMaxFrame = 1u << 20;
46
47enum RelayType : uint8_t {
48 RELAY_HELLO_HOST = 1,
49 RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT = 2,
50 RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT = 3,
51 RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT = 4,
52 RELAY_SEND = 5,
53 RELAY_DATA = 6,
54 RELAY_ERROR = 7
55};
56
57struct RelayHeader {
58 uint8_t type = 0;
59 uint32_t session_id = 0;
60 uint32_t client_id = 0;
61};
62
63struct Conn {
64 int fd = -1;
65 enum Role { UNKNOWN, HOST, CLIENT } role = UNKNOWN;
66 uint32_t session_id = 0;
67 uint32_t client_id = 0;
68 std::vector<uint8_t> rx;
69 uint32_t pending_len = 0;
70};
71
72struct Session {
73 int host_fd = -1;
74 uint32_t next_client_id = 1;
75 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, int> clients;
76};
77
78void set_nonblocking(int fd) {
79 int flags = fcntl(fd, F_GETFL, 0);
80 if (flags >= 0)
81 fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
82}
83
84bool send_all(int fd, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
85 size_t sent = 0;
86 while (sent < len) {
87 ssize_t n = ::send(fd, data + sent, len - sent, 0);
88 if (n > 0) {
89 sent += static_cast<size_t>(n);
90 continue;
91 }
92 if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)) {
93 pollfd pfd;
94 pfd.fd = fd;
95 pfd.events = POLLOUT;
96 pfd.revents = 0;
97 int rc = ::poll(&pfd, 1, 250);
98 if (rc <= 0)
99 return false;
100 continue;
101 }
102 return false;
103 }
104 return true;
105}
106
107bool send_frame(int fd, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
108 if (len == 0 || len > kMaxFrame)
109 return false;
110 uint8_t prefix[4];
111 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(len);
112 prefix[0] = static_cast<uint8_t>(v & 0xFF);
113 prefix[1] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
114 prefix[2] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
115 prefix[3] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
116 return send_all(fd, prefix, sizeof(prefix)) && send_all(fd, data, len);
117}
118
119void write_u32(std::vector<uint8_t> &out, uint32_t value) {
120 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(value & 0xFF));
121 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 8) & 0xFF));
122 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 16) & 0xFF));
123 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 24) & 0xFF));
124}
125
126bool read_u8(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint8_t &out) {
127 if (offset + 1 > size)
128 return false;
129 out = data[offset++];
130 return true;
131}
132
133bool read_u32(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint32_t &out) {
134 if (offset + 4 > size)
135 return false;
136 out = static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset]) |
137 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 1]) << 8) |
138 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 2]) << 16) |
139 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 3]) << 24);
140 offset += 4;
141 return true;
142}
143
144bool parse_relay_header(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, RelayHeader &out,
145 const uint8_t **payload, size_t *payload_len) {
146 size_t offset = 0;
147 uint32_t magic = 0;
148 uint8_t version = 0;
149 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, magic))
150 return false;
151 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, version))
152 return false;
153 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, out.type))
154 return false;
155 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.session_id))
156 return false;
157 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.client_id))
158 return false;
159 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
160 return false;
161 if (payload)
162 *payload = data + offset;
163 if (payload_len)
164 *payload_len = (offset <= size) ? (size - offset) : 0;
165 return true;
166}
167
168std::vector<uint8_t> make_relay_packet(uint8_t type, uint32_t session_id, uint32_t client_id,
169 const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len) {
170 std::vector<uint8_t> out;
171 out.reserve(4 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 4 + payload_len);
172 write_u32(out, kRelayMagic);
173 out.push_back(kRelayVersion);
174 out.push_back(type);
175 write_u32(out, session_id);
176 write_u32(out, client_id);
177 if (payload && payload_len)
178 out.insert(out.end(), payload, payload + payload_len);
179 return out;
180}
181
182bool pump_recv(Conn &c) {
183 uint8_t buf[4096];
184 while (true) {
185 ssize_t n = ::recv(c.fd, buf, sizeof(buf), 0);
186 if (n == 0)
187 return false;
188 if (n < 0) {
189 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
190 break;
191 return false;
192 }
193 c.rx.insert(c.rx.end(), buf, buf + n);
194 if (static_cast<size_t>(n) < sizeof(buf))
195 break;
196 }
197 return true;
198}
199
200bool try_extract_frame(Conn &c, std::vector<uint8_t> &out) {
201 out.clear();
202 if (c.pending_len == 0) {
203 if (c.rx.size() < 4)
204 return false;
205 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[0]) |
206 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[1]) << 8) |
207 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[2]) << 16) |
208 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[3]) << 24);
209 c.rx.erase(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + 4);
210 if (v == 0 || v > kMaxFrame) {
211 c.rx.clear();
212 c.pending_len = 0;
213 return false;
214 }
215 c.pending_len = v;
216 }
217 if (c.rx.size() < c.pending_len)
218 return false;
219 out.assign(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + c.pending_len);
220 c.rx.erase(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + c.pending_len);
221 c.pending_len = 0;
222 return true;
223}
224
225} // namespace
226
227int main(int argc, char **argv) {
228 std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
229 std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
230
231 const char *host = "0.0.0.0";
232 uint16_t port = 12349;
233 if (argc > 1)
234 host = argv[1];
235 if (argc > 2)
236 port = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::strtoul(argv[2], nullptr, 10));
237
238 addrinfo hints;
239 std::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
240 hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
241 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
242 hints.ai_flags = AI_PASSIVE;
243
244 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
245 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(port));
246 if (getaddrinfo(host, port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0) {
247 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to resolve bind address\n");
248 return 1;
249 }
250
251 int listen_fd = ::socket(res->ai_family, res->ai_socktype, res->ai_protocol);
252 if (listen_fd < 0) {
253 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to create socket\n");
254 freeaddrinfo(res);
255 return 1;
256 }
257
258 int opt = 1;
259 setsockopt(listen_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
260
261 if (::bind(listen_fd, res->ai_addr, static_cast<socklen_t>(res->ai_addrlen)) != 0) {
262 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to bind %s:%u\n", host, port);
263 freeaddrinfo(res);
264 close(listen_fd);
265 return 1;
266 }
267 freeaddrinfo(res);
268
269 if (::listen(listen_fd, 64) != 0) {
270 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to listen\n");
271 close(listen_fd);
272 return 1;
273 }
274
275 set_nonblocking(listen_fd);
276
277 std::printf("TCP relay server listening on %s:%u\n", host, port);
278
279 std::unordered_map<int, Conn> conns;
280 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Session> sessions;
281
282 while (true) {
283 std::vector<pollfd> fds;
284 fds.reserve(conns.size() + 1);
285 fds.push_back({listen_fd, POLLIN, 0});
286 for (const auto &kv : conns)
287 fds.push_back({kv.first, POLLIN, 0});
288
289 int rc = ::poll(fds.data(), fds.size(), 10);
290 if (rc < 0)
291 continue;
292
293 if (fds[0].revents & POLLIN) {
294 while (true) {
295 sockaddr_in addr;
296 socklen_t alen = sizeof(addr);
297 int fd = ::accept(listen_fd, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr *>(&addr), &alen);
298 if (fd < 0) {
299 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
300 break;
301 break;
302 }
303 set_nonblocking(fd);
304 conns[fd] = Conn{fd};
305 }
306 }
307
308 std::vector<int> to_close;
309 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
310
311 for (size_t i = 1; i < fds.size(); ++i) {
312 int fd = fds[i].fd;
313 if ((fds[i].revents & (POLLIN | POLLERR | POLLHUP)) == 0)
314 continue;
315 auto it = conns.find(fd);
316 if (it == conns.end())
317 continue;
318 Conn &c = it->second;
319
320 if (!pump_recv(c)) {
321 to_close.push_back(fd);
322 continue;
323 }
324
325 while (try_extract_frame(c, frame)) {
326 if (c.role == Conn::UNKNOWN) {
327 RelayHeader hdr;
328 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
329 size_t payload_len = 0;
330 if (!parse_relay_header(frame.data(), frame.size(), hdr, &payload, &payload_len)) {
331 to_close.push_back(fd);
332 break;
333 }
334 if (hdr.type == RELAY_HELLO_HOST) {
335 c.role = Conn::HOST;
336 c.session_id = hdr.session_id;
337 Session &s = sessions[c.session_id];
338 s.host_fd = fd;
339 // Notify host about already connected clients.
340 for (const auto &entry : s.clients) {
341 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT, c.session_id,
342 entry.first, nullptr, 0);
343 send_frame(fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
344 }
345 } else if (hdr.type == RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT) {
346 c.role = Conn::CLIENT;
347 c.session_id = hdr.session_id;
348 Session &s = sessions[c.session_id];
349 c.client_id = s.next_client_id++;
350 s.clients[c.client_id] = fd;
351 if (s.host_fd >= 0) {
352 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT, c.session_id,
353 c.client_id, nullptr, 0);
354 send_frame(s.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
355 }
356 } else {
357 to_close.push_back(fd);
358 break;
359 }
360 continue;
361 }
362
363 if (c.role == Conn::CLIENT) {
364 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
365 if (sit != sessions.end() && sit->second.host_fd >= 0) {
366 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_DATA, c.session_id, c.client_id,
367 frame.data(), frame.size());
368 send_frame(sit->second.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
369 }
370 continue;
371 }
372
373 if (c.role == Conn::HOST) {
374 RelayHeader hdr;
375 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
376 size_t payload_len = 0;
377 if (!parse_relay_header(frame.data(), frame.size(), hdr, &payload, &payload_len))
378 continue;
379 if (hdr.type != RELAY_SEND)
380 continue;
381 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
382 if (sit == sessions.end())
383 continue;
384 auto cit = sit->second.clients.find(hdr.client_id);
385 if (cit == sit->second.clients.end())
386 continue;
387 send_frame(cit->second, payload, payload_len);
388 continue;
389 }
390 }
391 }
392
393 // Apply queued disconnects (and send control notifications).
394 for (int fd : to_close) {
395 auto it = conns.find(fd);
396 if (it == conns.end())
397 continue;
398 Conn c = it->second;
399 conns.erase(it);
400 close(fd);
401
402 if (c.role == Conn::CLIENT) {
403 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
404 if (sit != sessions.end()) {
405 sit->second.clients.erase(c.client_id);
406 if (sit->second.host_fd >= 0) {
407 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT, c.session_id,
408 c.client_id, nullptr, 0);
409 send_frame(sit->second.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
410 }
411 if (sit->second.host_fd < 0 && sit->second.clients.empty())
412 sessions.erase(sit);
413 }
414 } else if (c.role == Conn::HOST) {
415 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
416 if (sit != sessions.end() && sit->second.host_fd == fd) {
417 // Close all clients when the host goes away.
418 for (const auto &entry : sit->second.clients) {
419 int cfd = entry.second;
420 auto cit = conns.find(cfd);
421 if (cit != conns.end()) {
422 conns.erase(cit);
423 close(cfd);
424 }
425 }
426 sessions.erase(sit);
427 }
428 }
429 }
430 }
431}
